Comments (English): [ Recently, as I am getting older, I am becoming more meticulous. ] || ---------------- || Recently, my eyesight has been worsening, and even when I wash dishes thoroughly, I often find residue afterward, so I decided to buy a dishwasher. The sheer variety of models and features made choosing a dishwasher overwhelming, but I tried to stick to the basics. I was tempted by models with pan holders and a horizontal spoon holder, but ultimately chose the sturdy, basic dishwasher. During installation, the sink mop tray interfered with the door, preventing it from opening. The solutions included removing the sink base, moving it inward, and inserting the mop tray deeper, or cutting the bottom of the sink base to accommodate the gap. Since I recently installed a new sink, I tried adjusting the base, but... I found a part of the floor that was missing the floorboard, so I ended up cutting out the baseboard. I felt sorry and grateful to the installer who proceeded without showing any displeasure even though it must have been a hassle. I also appreciated his understanding even though he kept vacuuming and wiping with wet tissues because he said the sawdust was flying around. If you look from the floor, there is a gap big enough for the dishwasher door to open at a right angle, but this is a normal installation. I am glad that it was cut so neatly and installed beautifully. I put it off for a while, but now that it is actually installed, I feel like a lot of congestion has gone away. For those who are hesitating, just order and get it installed quickly so that you can live comfortably for at least one day.

Sentence (English): I was previously using a Bespoke Freestanding Hot Air Dryer (Glam White).
Comments (English): [ I like it because it's quiet! ] || ---------------- || I was previously using a Bespoke Freestanding Hot Air Dryer (Glam White). When I moved, I brought it with me and installed it, but I was shocked by how loud it was. The noise and vibration were incredibly loud. Also, since it was a freestanding model, installing it under the sink would have been expensive and unattractive, so after much deliberation, I decided to purchase a built-in model. I was satisfied with the installation process. After purchasing, they visited me to confirm installation, and the installer was very friendly and provided detailed instructions, which gave me confidence. The additional installation fee was reasonable at around 30,000 won. I was also very satisfied with the color and design. My previous model had a black handle. After about a year of use, it started to become discolored and stained with water stains. No matter how much I cleaned it, it wouldn't come back clean, which was quite stressful. (Photo attached above) My friend had the same model and said the same thing. This new model is beautiful in all white. I think it will last a long time without worrying about water stains or discoloration. The white sink blends in well, and the overall look is clean and neat. The Bespoke panel design isn't as luxurious as the previous model, but it feels simpler and more streamlined, which I'm quite pleased with. Capacity and usability. It's rated for 14 people, but the difference in capacity isn't that significant compared to the 12-person model I used before. I think those who have used the previous Bespoke model will adapt quickly. The most satisfying aspect! Noise. It's incredibly quiet! The noise difference compared to the previous freestanding model is definitely noticeable. I can run it at night without any problems, which is the most satisfying aspect. Washing tips! I recommend the additional rinse setting! Adding too much detergent can cause water stains, so be sure to adjust the amount! Just the right amount! (Since you'll rinse it once anyway, you don't need much.) You'll get a feel for how much detergent you need with use, but I cut the amount in half and now my dishes are sparkling clean. At first, I was a bit concerned about water stains, and the fishy smell was annoying. With continued use, the water stains and smell will disappear. Also, since it was a freestanding model, installing it under the sink would have been expensive and unattractive, so after much deliberation, I decided to purchase a built-in model. I was satisfied with the installation process. After purchasing, they visited me to confirm installation, and the installer was very friendly and provided detailed instructions, which gave me confidence. The additional installation fee was reasonable at around 30,000 won. I was also very satisfied with the color and design. My previous model had a black handle. After about a year of use, it started to become discolored and stained with water stains. No matter how much I cleaned it, it wouldn't come back clean, which was quite stressful. (Photo attached above) My friend had the same model and said the same thing. This new model is beautiful in all white. I think it will last a long time without worrying about water stains or discoloration. The white sink blends in well, and the overall look is clean and neat. The Bespoke panel design isn't as luxurious as the previous model, but it feels simpler and more streamlined, which I'm quite pleased with. Capacity and usability. It's rated for 14 people, but the difference in capacity isn't that significant compared to the 12-person model I used before. I think those who have used the previous Bespoke model will adapt quickly. The most satisfying aspect! Noise. It's incredibly quiet! The noise difference compared to the previous freestanding model is definitely noticeable. I can run it at night without any problems, which is the most satisfying aspect. Washing tips! I recommend the additional rinse setting! Adding too much detergent can cause water stains, so be sure to adjust the amount! Just the right amount! (Since you'll rinse it once anyway, you don't need much.) You'll get a feel for how much detergent you need with use, but I cut the amount in half and now my dishes are sparkling clean. At first, I was a bit concerned about water stains, and the fishy smell was annoying. With continued use, the water stains and smell will disappear. Tips for removing water stains (tips from someone who's used the dishwasher for over 5 years!). Using rinse aid will prevent water stains! But it's expensive! These days, detergents can double as rinse aid, so I don't buy them, but I still get water stains. Don't overdo it, just cut the detergent in half and use a small amount. If necessary, try adding vinegar instead of rinse aid. It eliminates any odor and removes water stains cleanly! I always fill the rinse aid dispenser with a full glass of vinegar. (White vinegar, for cleaning, is incredibly useful in the kitchen.) If the smell bothers you, don't add any more vinegar! Here are some things to keep in mind before purchasing: - Freestanding products don't look good when installed under the sink due to the mop holder. - If you plan to install under an induction stove, be sure to purchase a built-in option. - Sink remodeling costs vary significantly between companies. Advantages of buying on Coupang: Lowest prices, reward points, and no worries about installation fees. A friend of mine had a sink remodel cost over 300,000 won after ordering through Naver. After installation, she checked with another company and found out it would have been around 100,000 won. Costs vary significantly between companies, so I recommend buying on Coupang. Quiet, clean design, reasonable installation cost. You'll definitely be satisfied with this product for all three. The differences between dishwashers are mostly in the cost of the panel case material. Since cleaning is the same anyway, I recommend buying the cheaper one. Oh, and if you're using an older sink, you might need to use a floating material, which costs more and looks less attractive. If you must use a floating material, there's a slim-type dishwasher. When I moved, I brought it with me and installed it, but I was shocked by how loud it was. The noise and vibration were incredibly loud. Also, since it was a freestanding model, installing it under the sink would have been expensive and unattractive, so after much deliberation, I decided to purchase a built-in model. I was satisfied with the installation process. After purchasing, they visited me to confirm installation, and the installer was very friendly and provided detailed instructions, which gave me confidence. The additional installation fee was reasonable at around 30,000 won. I was also very satisfied with the color and design. My previous model had a black handle. After about a year of use, it started to become discolored and stained with water stains. No matter how much I cleaned it, it wouldn't come back clean, which was quite stressful. (Photo attached above) My friend had the same model and said the same thing. This new model is beautiful in all white. I think it will last a long time without worrying about water stains or discoloration. The white sink blends in well, and the overall look is clean and neat. The Bespoke panel design isn't as luxurious as the previous model, but it feels simpler and more streamlined, which I'm quite pleased with. Capacity and usability. It's rated for 14 people, but the difference in capacity isn't that significant compared to the 12-person model I used before. I think those who have used the previous Bespoke model will adapt quickly. The most satisfying aspect! Noise. It's incredibly quiet! The noise difference compared to the previous freestanding model is definitely noticeable. I can run it at night without any problems, which is the most satisfying aspect. Washing tips! I recommend the additional rinse setting! Adding too much detergent can cause water stains, so be sure to adjust the amount! Just the right amount! (Since you'll rinse it once anyway, you don't need much.) You'll get a feel for how much detergent you need with use, but I cut the amount in half and now my dishes are sparkling clean. At first, I was a bit concerned about water stains, and the fishy smell was annoying. With continued use, the water stains and smell will disappear. Tips for removing water stains (tips from someone who's used the dishwasher for over 5 years!). Using rinse aid will prevent water stains! But it's expensive! These days, detergents can double as rinse aid, so I don't buy them, but I still get water stains. Don't overdo it, just cut the detergent in half and use a small amount. If necessary, try adding vinegar instead of rinse aid. It eliminates any odor and removes water stains cleanly! I always fill the rinse aid dispenser with a full glass of vinegar. (White vinegar, for cleaning, is incredibly useful in the kitchen.) If the smell bothers you, don't add any more vinegar! Here are some things to keep in mind before purchasing: - Freestanding products don't look good when installed under the sink due to the mop holder. - If you plan to install under an induction stove, be sure to purchase a built-in option. - Sink remodeling costs vary significantly between companies. Advantages of buying on Coupang: Lowest prices, reward points, and no worries about installation fees. A friend of mine had a sink remodel cost over 300,000 won after ordering through Naver. After installation, she checked with another company and found out it would have been around 100,000 won. Costs vary significantly between companies, so I recommend buying on Coupang. Quiet, clean design, reasonable installation cost. You'll definitely be satisfied with this product for all three. The differences between dishwashers are mostly in the cost of the panel case material. Since cleaning is the same anyway, I recommend buying the cheaper one. Oh, and if you're using an older sink, you might need to use a floating material, which costs more and looks less attractive. If you must use a floating material, there's a slim-type dishwasher. Also, since it was a freestanding model, installing it under the sink would have been expensive and unattractive, so after much deliberation, I decided to purchase a built-in model. I was satisfied with the installation process. After purchasing, they visited me to confirm installation, and the installer was very friendly and provided detailed instructions, which gave me confidence. The additional installation fee was reasonable at around 30,000 won. I was also very satisfied with the color and design. My previous model had a black handle. After about a year of use, it started to become discolored and stained with water stains. No matter how much I cleaned it, it wouldn't come back clean, which was quite stressful. (Photo attached above) My friend had the same model and said the same thing. This new model is beautiful in all white. I think it will last a long time without worrying about water stains or discoloration. The white sink blends in well, and the overall look is clean and neat. The Bespoke panel design isn't as luxurious as the previous model, but it feels simpler and more streamlined, which I'm quite pleased with. Capacity and usability. It's rated for 14 people, but the difference in capacity isn't that significant compared to the 12-person model I used before. I think those who have used the previous Bespoke model will adapt quickly. The most satisfying aspect! Noise. It's incredibly quiet! The noise difference compared to the previous freestanding model is definitely noticeable. I can run it at night without any problems, which is the most satisfying aspect. Washing tips! I recommend the additional rinse setting! Adding too much detergent can cause water stains, so be sure to adjust the amount! Just the right amount! (Since you'll rinse it once anyway, you don't need much.) You'll get a feel for how much detergent you need with use, but I cut the amount in half and now my dishes are sparkling clean. At first, I was a bit concerned about water stains, and the fishy smell was annoying. With continued use, the water stains and smell will disappear. Tips for removing water stains (tips from someone who's used the dishwasher for over 5 years!). Using rinse aid will prevent water stains! But it's expensive! These days, detergents can double as rinse aid, so I don't buy them, but I still get water stains. Don't overdo it, just cut the detergent in half and use a small amount. If necessary, try adding vinegar instead of rinse aid. It eliminates any odor and removes water stains cleanly! I always fill the rinse aid dispenser with a full glass of vinegar. (White vinegar, for cleaning, is incredibly useful in the kitchen.) If the smell bothers you, don't add any more vinegar! Quiet, clean design, reasonable installation cost. You'll definitely be satisfied with this product for all three. The differences between dishwashers are mostly in the cost of the panel case material. Since cleaning is the same anyway, I recommend buying the cheaper one. Also, since it was a freestanding model, installing it under the sink would have been expensive and unattractive, so after much deliberation, I decided to purchase a built-in model. I was satisfied with the installation process. After purchasing, they visited me to confirm installation, and the installer was very friendly and provided detailed instructions, which gave me confidence. The additional installation fee was reasonable at around 30,000 won. I was also very satisfied with the color and design. My previous model had a black handle. After about a year of use, it started to become discolored and stained with water stains. No matter how much I cleaned it, it wouldn't come back clean, which was quite stressful. (Photo attached above) My friend had the same model and said the same thing. This new model is beautiful in all white. I think it will last a long time without worrying about water stains or discoloration. The white sink blends in well, and the overall look is clean and neat. The Bespoke panel design isn't as luxurious as the previous model, but it feels simpler and more streamlined, which I'm quite pleased with. Capacity and usability. It's rated for 14 people, but the difference in capacity isn't that significant compared to the 12-person model I used before. I think those who have used the previous Bespoke model will adapt quickly. The most satisfying aspect! Noise. It's incredibly quiet! The noise difference compared to the previous freestanding model is definitely noticeable. I can run it at night without any problems, which is the most satisfying aspect. Washing tips! I recommend the additional rinse setting! Adding too much detergent can cause water stains, so be sure to adjust the amount! Just the right amount! (Since you'll rinse it once anyway, you don't need much.) You'll get a feel for how much detergent you need with use, but I cut the amount in half and now my dishes are sparkling clean. At first, I was a bit concerned about water stains, and the fishy smell was annoying. With continued use, the water stains and smell will disappear. Tips for removing water stains (tips from someone who's used the dishwasher for over 5 years!). Using rinse aid will prevent water stains! But it's expensive! These days, detergents can double as rinse aid, so I don't buy them, but I still get water stains. Don't overdo it, just cut the detergent in half and use a small amount. If necessary, try adding vinegar instead of rinse aid. It eliminates any odor and removes water stains cleanly! I always fill the rinse aid dispenser with a full glass of vinegar. (White vinegar, for cleaning, is incredibly useful in the kitchen.) If the smell bothers you, don't add any more vinegar! Here are some things to keep in mind before purchasing: - Freestanding products don't look good when installed under the sink due to the mop holder. - If you plan to install under an induction stove, be sure to purchase a built-in option. - Sink remodeling costs vary significantly between companies. Advantages of buying on Coupang: Lowest prices, reward points, and no worries about installation fees. A friend of mine had a sink remodel cost over 300,000 won after ordering through Naver. After installation, she checked with another company and found out it would have been around 100,000 won. Costs vary significantly between companies, so I recommend buying on Coupang. Quiet, clean design, reasonable installation cost. You'll definitely be satisfied with this product for all three. The differences between dishwashers are mostly in the cost of the panel case material. Since cleaning is the same anyway, I recommend buying the cheaper one. Oh, and if you're using an older sink, you might need to use a floating material, which costs more and looks less attractive. If you must use a floating material, there's a slim-type dishwasher. I recommend the additional rinse setting! Adding too much detergent can cause water stains, so be sure to adjust the amount! Just the right amount! When I moved, I brought it with me and installed it, but I was shocked by how loud it was. The noise and vibration were incredibly loud. Also, since it was a freestanding model, installing it under the sink would have been expensive and unattractive, so after much deliberation, I decided to purchase a built-in model. I was satisfied with the installation process. After purchasing, they visited me to confirm installation, and the installer was very friendly and provided detailed instructions, which gave me confidence. The additional installation fee was reasonable at around 30,000 won. I was also very satisfied with the color and design. My previous model had a black handle. After about a year of use, it started to become discolored and stained with water stains. No matter how much I cleaned it, it wouldn't come back clean, which was quite stressful. (Photo attached above) My friend had the same model and said the same thing. This new model is beautiful in all white. I think it will last a long time without worrying about water stains or discoloration. The white sink blends in well, and the overall look is clean and neat. The Bespoke panel design isn't as luxurious as the previous model, but it feels simpler and more streamlined, which I'm quite pleased with. Capacity and usability. It's rated for 14 people, but the difference in capacity isn't that significant compared to the 12-person model I used before. I think those who have used the previous Bespoke model will adapt quickly. The most satisfying aspect! Noise. It's incredibly quiet! The noise difference compared to the previous freestanding model is definitely noticeable. I can run it at night without any problems, which is the most satisfying aspect. Washing tips! I recommend the additional rinse setting! Adding too much detergent can cause water stains, so be sure to adjust the amount! Just the right amount! (Since you'll rinse it once anyway, you don't need much.) You'll get a feel for how much detergent you need with use, but I cut the amount in half and now my dishes are sparkling clean. At first, I was a bit concerned about water stains, and the fishy smell was annoying. With continued use, the water stains and smell will disappear. Tips for removing water stains (tips from someone who's used the dishwasher for over 5 years!). Using rinse aid will prevent water stains! But it's expensive! These days, detergents can double as rinse aid, so I don't buy them, but I still get water stains. Don't overdo it, just cut the detergent in half and use a small amount. If necessary, try adding vinegar instead of rinse aid. It eliminates any odor and removes water stains cleanly! I always fill the rinse aid dispenser with a full glass of vinegar. (White vinegar, for cleaning, is incredibly useful in the kitchen.) If the smell bothers you, don't add any more vinegar! Here are some things to keep in mind before purchasing: - Freestanding products don't look good when installed under the sink due to the mop holder. - If you plan to install under an induction stove, be sure to purchase a built-in option. - Sink remodeling costs vary significantly between companies. Advantages of buying on Coupang: Lowest prices, reward points, and no worries about installation fees. A friend of mine had a sink remodel cost over 300,000 won after ordering through Naver. After installation, she checked with another company and found out it would have been around 100,000 won. Costs vary significantly between companies, so I recommend buying on Coupang. Quiet, clean design, reasonable installation cost. You'll definitely be satisfied with this product for all three. The differences between dishwashers are mostly in the cost of the panel case material. Since cleaning is the same anyway, I recommend buying the cheaper one. Oh, and if you're using an older sink, you might need to use a floating material, which costs more and looks less attractive. If you must use a floating material, there's a slim-type dishwasher. These days, detergents can double as rinse aid, so I don't buy them, but I still get water stains. Don't overdo it, just cut the detergent in half and use a small amount. When I moved, I brought it with me and installed it, but I was shocked by how loud it was. The noise and vibration were incredibly loud. Also, since it was a freestanding model, installing it under the sink would have been expensive and unattractive, so after much deliberation, I decided to purchase a built-in model. I was satisfied with the installation process. After purchasing, they visited me to confirm installation, and the installer was very friendly and provided detailed instructions, which gave me confidence. The additional installation fee was reasonable at around 30,000 won. I was also very satisfied with the color and design. My previous model had a black handle. After about a year of use, it started to become discolored and stained with water stains. No matter how much I cleaned it, it wouldn't come back clean, which was quite stressful. (Photo attached above) My friend had the same model and said the same thing. This new model is beautiful in all white. I think it will last a long time without worrying about water stains or discoloration. The white sink blends in well, and the overall look is clean and neat. The Bespoke panel design isn't as luxurious as the previous model, but it feels simpler and more streamlined, which I'm quite pleased with. Capacity and usability. It's rated for 14 people, but the difference in capacity isn't that significant compared to the 12-person model I used before. I think those who have used the previous Bespoke model will adapt quickly. The most satisfying aspect! Noise. It's incredibly quiet! The noise difference compared to the previous freestanding model is definitely noticeable. I can run it at night without any problems, which is the most satisfying aspect. Washing tips! I recommend the additional rinse setting! Adding too much detergent can cause water stains, so be sure to adjust the amount! Just the right amount! (Since you'll rinse it once anyway, you don't need much.) You'll get a feel for how much detergent you need with use, but I cut the amount in half and now my dishes are sparkling clean. At first, I was a bit concerned about water stains, and the fishy smell was annoying. With continued use, the water stains and smell will disappear. Tips for removing water stains (tips from someone who's used the dishwasher for over 5 years!). Using rinse aid will prevent water stains! But it's expensive! These days, detergents can double as rinse aid, so I don't buy them, but I still get water stains. Don't overdo it, just cut the detergent in half and use a small amount. If necessary, try adding vinegar instead of rinse aid. It eliminates any odor and removes water stains cleanly! I always fill the rinse aid dispenser with a full glass of vinegar. (White vinegar, for cleaning, is incredibly useful in the kitchen.) If the smell bothers you, don't add any more vinegar! Here are some things to keep in mind before purchasing: - Freestanding products don't look good when installed under the sink due to the mop holder. - If you plan to install under an induction stove, be sure to purchase a built-in option. - Sink remodeling costs vary significantly between companies. Advantages of buying on Coupang: Lowest prices, reward points, and no worries about installation fees. A friend of mine had a sink remodel cost over 300,000 won after ordering through Naver. After installation, she checked with another company and found out it would have been around 100,000 won. Costs vary significantly between companies, so I recommend buying on Coupang. Quiet, clean design, reasonable installation cost. You'll definitely be satisfied with this product for all three. The differences between dishwashers are mostly in the cost of the panel case material. Since cleaning is the same anyway, I recommend buying the cheaper one. Oh, and if you're using an older sink, you might need to use a floating material, which costs more and looks less attractive. If you must use a floating material, there's a slim-type dishwasher. You might want to look into that too. How to get a 10% appliance rebate. Attaching a receipt doesn't get you a refund. Just download the My Page transaction statement, write your name, and submit it, indicating the number of attachments (you need to use the PC version). Check/print your PC receipt. 1. When I moved, I brought it with me and installed it, but I was shocked by how loud it was. The noise and vibration were incredibly loud. Also, since it was a freestanding model, installing it under the sink would have been expensive and unattractive, so after much deliberation, I decided to purchase a built-in model. I was satisfied with the installation process. After purchasing, they visited me to confirm installation, and the installer was very friendly and provided detailed instructions, which gave me confidence. The additional installation fee was reasonable at around 30,000 won. I was also very satisfied with the color and design. My previous model had a black handle. After about a year of use, it started to become discolored and stained with water stains. No matter how much I cleaned it, it wouldn't come back clean, which was quite stressful. (Photo attached above) My friend had the same model and said the same thing. This new model is beautiful in all white. I think it will last a long time without worrying about water stains or discoloration. The white sink blends in well, and the overall look is clean and neat. The Bespoke panel design isn't as luxurious as the previous model, but it feels simpler and more streamlined, which I'm quite pleased with. Capacity and usability. It's rated for 14 people, but the difference in capacity isn't that significant compared to the 12-person model I used before. I think those who have used the previous Bespoke model will adapt quickly. The most satisfying aspect! Noise. It's incredibly quiet! The noise difference compared to the previous freestanding model is definitely noticeable. I can run it at night without any problems, which is the most satisfying aspect. Washing tips! I recommend the additional rinse setting! Adding too much detergent can cause water stains, so be sure to adjust the amount! Just the right amount! (Since you'll rinse it once anyway, you don't need much.) You'll get a feel for how much detergent you need with use, but I cut the amount in half and now my dishes are sparkling clean. At first, I was a bit concerned about water stains, and the fishy smell was annoying. With continued use, the water stains and smell will disappear. Tips for removing water stains (tips from someone who's used the dishwasher for over 5 years!). Using rinse aid will prevent water stains! But it's expensive! These days, detergents can double as rinse aid, so I don't buy them, but I still get water stains. Don't overdo it, just cut the detergent in half and use a small amount. If necessary, try adding vinegar instead of rinse aid. It eliminates any odor and removes water stains cleanly! I always fill the rinse aid dispenser with a full glass of vinegar. (White vinegar, for cleaning, is incredibly useful in the kitchen.) If the smell bothers you, don't add any more vinegar! Here are some things to keep in mind before purchasing: - Freestanding products don't look good when installed under the sink due to the mop holder. - If you plan to install under an induction stove, be sure to purchase a built-in option. - Sink remodeling costs vary significantly between companies. Advantages of buying on Coupang: Lowest prices, reward points, and no worries about installation fees. A friend of mine had a sink remodel cost over 300,000 won after ordering through Naver. After installation, she checked with another company and found out it would have been around 100,000 won. Costs vary significantly between companies, so I recommend buying on Coupang. Quiet, clean design, reasonable installation cost. You'll definitely be satisfied with this product for all three. The differences between dishwashers are mostly in the cost of the panel case material. Since cleaning is the same anyway, I recommend buying the cheaper one. Oh, and if you're using an older sink, you might need to use a floating material, which costs more and looks less attractive. If you must use a floating material, there's a slim-type dishwasher. Also, since it was a freestanding model, installing it under the sink would have been expensive and unattractive, so after much deliberation, I decided to purchase a built-in model. I was satisfied with the installation process. After purchasing, they visited me to confirm installation, and the installer was very friendly and provided detailed instructions, which gave me confidence. The additional installation fee was reasonable at around 30,000 won. I was also very satisfied with the color and design. My previous model had a black handle. After about a year of use, it started to become discolored and stained with water stains. No matter how much I cleaned it, it wouldn't come back clean, which was quite stressful. (Photo attached above) My friend had the same model and said the same thing. This new model is beautiful in all white. I think it will last a long time without worrying about water stains or discoloration. The white sink blends in well, and the overall look is clean and neat. The Bespoke panel design isn't as luxurious as the previous model, but it feels simpler and more streamlined, which I'm quite pleased with. Capacity and usability. It's rated for 14 people, but the difference in capacity isn't that significant compared to the 12-person model I used before. I think those who have used the previous Bespoke model will adapt quickly. The most satisfying aspect! Noise. It's incredibly quiet! The noise difference compared to the previous freestanding model is definitely noticeable. I can run it at night without any problems, which is the most satisfying aspect. Washing tips! I recommend the additional rinse setting! Adding too much detergent can cause water stains, so be sure to adjust the amount! Just the right amount! (Since you'll rinse it once anyway, you don't need much.) You'll get a feel for how much detergent you need with use, but I cut the amount in half and now my dishes are sparkling clean. At first, I was a bit concerned about water stains, and the fishy smell was annoying. With continued use, the water stains and smell will disappear. Tips for removing water stains (tips from someone who's used the dishwasher for over 5 years!). Using rinse aid will prevent water stains! But it's expensive! These days, detergents can double as rinse aid, so I don't buy them, but I still get water stains. Don't overdo it, just cut the detergent in half and use a small amount. If necessary, try adding vinegar instead of rinse aid. It eliminates any odor and removes water stains cleanly! I always fill the rinse aid dispenser with a full glass of vinegar. (White vinegar, for cleaning, is incredibly useful in the kitchen.) If the smell bothers you, don't add any more vinegar! Here are some things to keep in mind before purchasing: - Freestanding products don't look good when installed under the sink due to the mop holder. - If you plan to install under an induction stove, be sure to purchase a built-in option. - Sink remodeling costs vary significantly between companies. Advantages of buying on Coupang: Lowest prices, reward points, and no worries about installation fees. A friend of mine had a sink remodel cost over 300,000 won after ordering through Naver. After installation, she checked with another company and found out it would have been around 100,000 won. Costs vary significantly between companies, so I recommend buying on Coupang. Quiet, clean design, reasonable installation cost. You'll definitely be satisfied with this product for all three. The differences between dishwashers are mostly in the cost of the panel case material. Since cleaning is the same anyway, I recommend buying the cheaper one. Oh, and if you're using an older sink, you might need to use a floating material, which costs more and looks less attractive. If you must use a floating material, there's a slim-type dishwasher. No noise, completely silent. ] || ---------------- || I'd been using a third-party dishwasher for quite some time, but recently, its cleaning power has noticeably declined and it's been malfunctioning more frequently, leading me to decide to replace it. Once it started to break, the repair costs were prohibitive, and since it's an appliance I use every day, it was incredibly stressful. I wanted to upgrade to a more reliable product, so after comparing several brands, I chose the LG Electronics Dios Objet Collection 14-seater Built-in Dishwasher. The most satisfying part was the installation process. I was worried that a built-in product would be difficult to install, but the on-site installer arrived promptly and meticulously, from the time the installation was scheduled to remove the old unit to the new one. He even explained usage and maintenance tips with care, which gave me confidence from the first impression. The Nature Beige color is much more luxurious in person than in the photos, blending seamlessly with my kitchen interior and truly capturing the Objet Collection's signature aesthetic. The biggest difference from my previous appliance is the internal structure and storage options. Previous models required knives and spoons to be crammed into one space, making them difficult to clean. The placement of frying pans and pots was often awkward. This model, however, features separate knife and spoon compartments, making it much more hygienic and efficient to clean. I'm also pleased with how the blades are organized to prevent them from hitting each other, and the deep cutlery tray ensures stable storage without wobbling. Another thing I love about this model is how it utilizes the space for frying pans and pots. The middle and bottom compartments are designed to be very practical, allowing for the storage of even large frying pans and pots without any issues. The bottom compartment is particularly spacious, allowing for an entire 10-person pressure cooker with room to spare. Previously, washing such large utensils by hand was a hassle, but now it's incredibly convenient to be able to load and unload them all at once. Since we're a family of five, we initially debated between a 12-person and a 14-person model, but ultimately, choosing the 14-person version was a wise decision. Considering the number of people, it might seem excessive, but in practice, the ample space for not only dishes but also cooking utensils makes it much more efficient. Dishes, pots, and pans can be processed in one go after a meal, eliminating the need for multiple washes a day. This significantly improves space utilization. The cleaning power also exceeds expectations. Even greasy dishes and dishes with stuck-on food are thoroughly cleaned without any pre-rinsing, and glassware and plates are barely stained, resulting in a satisfying result. The drying function also works well, ensuring the dishwasher remains fluffy and ready to be put away immediately. It's also quiet during operation, making it ideal for evenings and nights. Overall, I'm very satisfied with the design, storage layout, cleaning power, and convenience. I highly recommend this dishwasher to anyone considering replacing their old one or to anyone seeking ample storage and efficient use of space for their family. While it's on the pricey side, it's well worth the price for an appliance they use every day. Just replacing the dishwasher has made kitchen work so much easier and I feel like my quality of life has definitely improved.

I'm also pleased with how the blades are organized to prevent them from hitting each other, and the deep cutlery tray ensures stable storage without wobbling. I highly recommend this dishwasher to anyone considering replacing their old one or to anyone seeking ample storage and efficient use of space for their family. While it's on the pricey side, it's well worth the price for an appliance they use every day. Just replacing the dishwasher has made kitchen work so much easier and I feel like my quality of life has definitely improved.

I highly recommend this dishwasher to anyone considering replacing their old one or to anyone seeking ample storage and efficient use of space for their family. Overall, I'm very satisfied with the design, storage layout, cleaning power, and convenience. Sentence (English): I'm satisfied overall, but this Maytag doesn't remove tea/coffee stain residue.
Comments (English): I'm satisfied overall, but this Maytag doesn't remove tea/coffee stain residue. My daughter puts knives in the utensil rack facing down and it wasn't able to clean some of the blade of the knives completely. So, it appears we still need to scrub most dishes off before putting them in. Also, doesn't completely dry off everything, if that would bother you. There's still a bit of water on top of mugs, for example.Note to future customers: I paid $50 extra ahead of time to have them remove my old dishwasher and when the delivery guys said they couldn't take it unless it was completely unhooked from water hoses, etc. Fortunately, I had already disconnected everything right before they got there. Also, make sure you have an air gap installed already on your sink top or they will charge you a bunch of extra to install one, if you are having them install it in the first place, vs. doing it yourself. I told them I didn't want them to install it, because I didn't have an air gap already and it's code here in California that you must have one. I saved hundreds of dollars by installing both the air gap and the dishwasher myself. I'm a 60+ year-old woman, and I was able to install both myself, successfully, but it wasn't as easy as I thought it would be. Still, worth the savings of more than several hundred dollars that I would have had to pay somebody else to do all of that. Hope this saves someone from frustrations later, because they don't necessarily tell you any of this ahead of time.

Sentence (English): Great dishwasher overall.
Comments (English): Great dishwasher overall. It's very quiet and cleans extremely well. Dishes come out spotless after each cycle.The drying performance could be better. There is no heating element at the bottom; it relies on fans and hot air circulation, so you need to make sure the airflow isn't blocked. I also feel like my old 10-year-old dishwasher could hold more dishes, but that may just be me getting used to the different rack layout.One feature I really like is the app—it shows how much water and power the dishwasher uses, which is a nice touch. I do wish there was a dedicated drying-only option, or an extra-dry setting, especially for drying hand-washed dishes.Overall, it's a great, quiet, and efficient dishwasher with modern features, just with a few minor drawbacks.

Sentence (English): I'm satisfied overall, but this Maytag doesn't remove tea/coffee stain residue.
Comments (English): I'm satisfied overall, but this Maytag doesn't remove tea/coffee stain residue. My daughter puts knives in the utensil rack facing down and it wasn't able to clean some of the blade of the knives completely. So, it appears we still need to scrub most dishes off before putting them in. Also, doesn't completely dry off everything, if that would bother you. There's still a bit of water on top of mugs, for example. Note to future customers: I paid $50 extra ahead of time to have them remove my old dishwasher and when the delivery guys said they couldn't take it unless it was completely unhooked from water hoses, etc. Fortunately, I had already disconnected everything right before they got there. Also, make sure you have an air gap installed already on your sink top or they will charge you a bunch of extra to install one, if you are having them install it in the first place, vs. doing it yourself. I told them I didn't want them to install it, because I didn't have an air gap already and it's code here in California that you must have one. I saved hundreds of dollars by installing both the air gap and the dishwasher myself. I'm a 60+ year-old woman, and I was able to install both myself, successfully, but it wasn't as easy as I thought it would be. Still, worth the savings of more than several hundred dollars that I would have had to pay somebody else to do all of that. Hope this saves someone from frustrations later, because they don't necessarily tell you any of this ahead of time.

Comments (English): (5/5). Review of the LG Dios Objet Collection Built-in Dishwasher (DUE5MBL2E), a 14-seater dishwasher. This was my first dishwasher, so I was really worried, but to be honest, I'm so satisfied that I wonder why I waited so long to buy it. Cleaning power was my biggest concern, but it exceeded my expectations. It cleans even dishes with dried rice and greasy frying pans without leaving any residue. I'm especially pleased with how clean it is, even when I mix baby and regular dishes, without any odors. Noise: It's so quiet that I have to check to see if it's running. I can even run it at night without any problems, and it doesn't bother me even when the living room and kitchen are close together. Storage and Interior Design: It's a 14-seater, so it can hold pots, frying pans, plates, and cups all at once. The well-designed upper/middle/lower baskets make it easy to organize dishes according to their size. It's also great for holding baby bottles and small dishes. Design: The Objet Collection Nature Manhattan Midnight color really brightens up the kitchen. The built-in design makes the kitchen look much cleaner and more luxurious. It also shows fewer fingerprints than I expected. Convenient features: Thanks to the automatic door-opening drying function, there are virtually no water stains, and dishes dry quickly. The intuitive button operation makes it easy for seniors to use. Installation satisfaction: The on-site installer was friendly and provided thorough instructions. It was great that it was ready to use right away. Overall: Washing dishes was incredibly stressful for me as a parent, but this product has significantly reduced my household chores. I'm satisfied with everything, from the cleaning power and noise reduction to the design. Despite its price tag, I think it's well worth the price. I highly recommend this dishwasher to anyone considering one!

Sentence (English): +Two-Month Usage Review .
Comments (English): [ I bought the 3-person size, but then I bought the 12-person size on Carrot Market... ] || ---------------- || +Two-Month Usage Review . Water stains are hit-or-miss; sometimes they remain, sometimes they don't. . My electricity bill increased by about 20,000 won after getting the dishwasher (I'm not sure if this is the reason). . Items that are slightly stuck on, like spatulas or bowls containing yogurt, don't get cleaned. <Because the induction cooktop in my apartment is a difficult type to install. The total additional cost was 170,000 won!> - Case sold separately + LG installation fee. Purchase Motivation & Reason for Selection . As a family of three, I liked the generous capacity of the 12-place setting, which allows us to handle large dishes at once. Since it is a built-in type, the kitchen looks much cleaner, so I was very satisfied with the installation. I was able to purchase it at a relatively affordable price on Coupang, and the fast Rocket Delivery + installation service was convenient (the installer came in person and even connected the drainage and water supply). . . Actual Installation Process . The installer came and installed it neatly into the side of the existing sink as a built-in unit. They also meticulously handled the water/drainage pipe connections and checked the power supply. My first impression was very good because it operated stably without any leaks during the first run after installation. User Experience & Function Review. Capacity & Storage. At first, I thought it would be big since it is a 12-place setting, but it actually fits a lot of dishes at once, proving its true value especially for guests or weekend housework. Thanks to the spacious interior, I was able to store frying pans, large plates, and cups, and the plate height adjustment is just right. Washing Power. The water temperature is high, and the rotating water jets spread strongly, resulting in a thorough dishwashing experience. Even heavily greasy dishes are almost completely clean after the cycle, significantly reducing the need to scrub them by hand. In fact, there are various wash courses available, so I select the appropriate one for the situation, such as Automatic, Powerful, and Standard. Noise & Ease of Use. The noise level during washing is comparable to that of a typical appliance, and when set to Quiet mode, it operates quietly enough that it is not bothersome even in the evening. It was also convenient that the remaining time is displayed on the front panel during operation, allowing me to see how much is left at a glance. Drying Performance. Most of the water is gone by the time the machine reaches the drying stage after washing, reducing the hassle of having to wipe each dish with a towel.
Comments (Original): [ 3인용샀다가 당근하고 12인용으로 구매했어요.ᐟ.ᐟ.ᐟ ] || ---------------- || +두달 사용후기 물 때는 복불복으로 남을때도 있고 안남을 때도 있음 식기세척기 들이고 전기세가 2만원정도 오름(이것때문인지 모르겠음) 뒤집개나 요거트 담은 그릇처럼 좀 눌러붙은 건 세척 안됨<아파트 인덕션이 설치하기 어려운 타입이라서 추가비용은 총 17만원 들었음!> -케이스 별도구매+엘지설치비용 구매 계기 & 선택 이유✔️ 3인 족인데 큰 식기들도 한 번에 처리 가능한 12인용이라 넉넉한 용량이 마음에 들었어요.✔️ 빌트인 타입이라 주방이 훨씬 깔끔해 보여 설치 만족도가 높았고요.✔️ 쿠팡에서 비교적 부담 없는 가격대로 구매 가능했고, 빠른 로켓배송 + 설치 서비스도 편리했어요 (설치기사님이 직접 와서 배수/급수 연결까지 해줬습니다).  ￼⸻ 실제 설치 과정설치 기사님이 오셔서 빌트인 형태로 기존 싱크대 측면에 쏙 넣어주셨고, 수도/배수관 연결, 전원 확인까지 꼼꼼히 처리해주셨어요.설치 후 첫 작동 시 물 새는 곳 없이 안정적이어서 첫인상이 아주 좋았습니다.⸻️ 사용감 & 기능 리뷰✔️ 용량 & 수납처음엔 “12인용이라 크겠지?” 했는데 실제로 접시 한 번에 많이 들어가서 특히 손님 방문이나 주말 가사일에 진가를 발휘해요.넉넉한 내부 덕에 프라이팬, 큰 접시, 컵 등 모두 수납 가능했고, 접시 높이 조절도 적당해요.✔️ 세척력물 온도가 높고, 회전하는 물살이 강하게 퍼지면서 말끔하게 설거지가 돼요.기름때가 많은 접시도 사이클 끝나면 거의 깨끗해져서 손으로 문질러야 할 일이 많이 줄었어요. 실제로 세척 코스가 다양해서 “자동→강력→표준” 등 상황에 맞게 선택하고 있어요.  ￼✔️ 소음 & 사용 편의세척 중 소음은 일반적인 가전 수준이고, 조용 모드 설정 시에는 저녁에도 부담 없을 정도로 작동해요.작동 도중에도 남은 시간 표시가 전면에 표시돼서 얼마나 남았는지 한눈에 볼 수 있는 점도 편했습니다.  ￼✔️ 건조 성능세척 후 건조 단계까지 진행하면 대부분 물기가 사라져서 그릇마다 수건으로 닦아야 하는 번거로움이 줄었어요.

Sentence (English): I appreciate that you keep quality products in your sales program for a long time (even more than 10 years) and only upgrade them with technological and functional changes/innovations.
Comments (English): [ Evaluation of the new machine compared to the previous one ] || ---------------- || I appreciate that you keep quality products in your sales program for a long time (even more than 10 years) and only upgrade them with technological and functional changes/innovations. With the new SMS6ECW15E dishwasher, we replaced your previous SMS58M92EU machine, which has been reliably and efficiently (without errors or downtime) in washing dishes in our kitchen every day for the last 14 years and we were very satisfied with it. When dirty dishes were placed in the machine, we removed all food residues, leaving only small, thin areas of fat and small food residues in the corners of the dishes. Thus, we used the machine only in economical programs (mostly Auto 45º-65º) and small amounts of powder without aggressive additives. We will continue with this method of washing in the new machine and I hope that it will continue to operate reliably and efficiently in the long term. What I like about the new machine is that it has retained most of the functionality from the previous machine, which we have become accustomed to and incorporated into our washing habits over the many years of using the machine, especially the shape and dimensions of all three baskets, the types of programs and additional functions, and the way the machine is operated. I would like to praise the new technical solutions and functionalities: - round protection of the rod holders and other plastic protections in the baskets, which will, I hope, ensure a longer life for the plastic protection of the basket parts (in the old machine, the plastic protection in exposed areas began to disintegrate after approx. 10 years of use) - additional Extra Clean Zone functionality in the middle basket - additional washing programs - automatic door opening after the end of the wash for faster drying of dishes - Home Connect mobile application: I will use it mainly for easy viewing and occasional changing of settings, for statistical monitoring of operation and occasional transfer of programs and remote activation I do not like, - that it is not possible to place the rod holders for plates in the front left part of the middle basket, as was possible in the previous machine. In our small family (most of the time 2), the number of plates in our usual washing is smaller than you might expect, and we would like to have more space to easily place other larger dishes (pots, pans) - the position of the control buttons and the entire display on the top of the door, which makes it impossible to fully view the settings with the door closed while the machine is running. But since this is solved by a comprehensive overview in the Home Connect app, it is an acceptable compromise.
Comments (Original): [ Ocena novega stroja v primerjavi s predhodnim ] || ---------------- || Cenim, da kakovostne izdelke dolgo časa (tudi več kot 10 let) zadržujete v prodajnem programu in jih le nadgrajujete z tehnološkimi in funkcionalnimi spremembami/novostmi. Z novim pomivalnim strojem SMS6ECW15E smo zamenjali dosedanji vaš stroj SMS58M92EU, ki je zanesljivo in učinkovito (brez napak in zastojev) vsakodnevno sodeloval v pomivanju posode v naši kuhinji zadnjih 14 let in smo bili z njim zelo zadovoljni. Pri umazani posodi smo, preden smo jo zložili v stroj, odstranili vse ostanke hrane, ostali so le manjši tanjši maščobni predeli  in manjši ostanki hrane v vogalih posode. Tako smo uporabljali stroj le pri varčnih programih (večinoma Auto 45º-65º) in manjše količine praška brez agresivnih dodatkov. S takim načinom pomivanja bomo nadaljevali tudi v novem stroju in upam, da bo nadaljeval z zanesljivem in učinkovitem dolgoročnim delovanjem.Pri novem stroju mi je všeč, da je ohranil večino funkcionalnosti iz predhodnega stroja, na katere smo se navadili in jih vključili v naše pomivalne navade v dolgih letih uporabe stroja, predvsem obliko in dimenzije vseh treh košar, vrste programov in dodatnih funkcij in načinom upravljanja stroja.Pohvalil bi nove tehnične rešitve in funkcionalnosti:- okroglo zaščito paličnih nosilcev in drugih plastičnih zaščit v košarah, kar bo, upam, zagotovilo daljšo dobo plastične zaščite delov košar (pri starem stroju je plastična zaščita na izpostavljenih mestih začela razpadati po cca. 10 letih uporabe)- dodatno funkcionalnost Extra Clean Zone v srednji košari- dodatne programe pomivanja- avtomatsko odpiranje vrat po zaključku pranja za hitrejše sušenje posode- mobilno aplikacijo Home Connect: sam jo bom uporabljal predvsem za enostaven pregled in občasno spreminjanje nastavitev, za statistično spremljanje delovanja in občasen prenos programov in vklop na daljavoNi mi všeč, - da v sprednjem levem delu srednje košare ni možno poleči paličnih nosilcev za krožnike, kot je bilo možno v predhodnem stroju. V naši maloštevilni družini (večino časa 2) je število krožnikov pri našem običajnem pomivanju manjše od vaših predvidevanj, in bi želeli imeti več prostora za lažjo namestitev ostale večje posode (loncev, kozic)- pozicija tipk za upravljanje in celoten prikaz na zgornji strani vrat, kar onemogoča celoten pregled nastavitev pri zaprtih vratih med delovanjem stroja. A ker to rešuje celovit pregled v aplikaciji Home Connect, je to sprejemljiva kompromisna rešitev.

Sentence (English): I bought this Bosch dishwasher a month ago to replace a 30 year old loud inefficient dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Cleans great and it's Quiet! ] || ---------------- || I bought this Bosch dishwasher a month ago to replace a 30 year old loud inefficient dishwasher. I'm amazed at how well it works. I almost didn't buy it because of some of the reviews. It dries the dishes very well. I'm amazed at how well it cleans the dishes. I'm so used to having to basically wash the dishes before putting them in the dishwasher. So I put it through the test and it cleans great. It is so quiet. I love the black aluminum. I haven't tried the Home Connect option yet. Honestly I didn't want a "smart" dishwasher, I would rather just push the buttons on the dishwasher and not have to fuss with an app on my phone. The instructions could be improved, I recommend watching the videos on the Bosch website, they are helpful, and maybe I will learn more with the app. I do recommend this dishwasher, it cleans and dries great and it is quiet!

Sentence (English): Remember when you could go in a store and actually see a major appliance before you bought it?

Sentence (English): I recently purchased this particular Profile dishwasher completely on faith due to the great experience I had with the 10 yo Profile dishwasher it was replacing.
Comments (English): [ CHEAP CHEAP CHEAP ] || ---------------- || I recently purchased this particular Profile dishwasher completely on faith due to the great experience I had with the 10 yo Profile dishwasher it was replacing. I regret my decision. Clearly GE/Haier made the decision to use low quality materials in a product line that is supposed to be a step up from mainline GE. CHEAP CHEAP CHEAP are the only words I can use to describe the materials used in its construction. I fully expect this one will not last the 10 years the last one did. The other disappointment is the addition of features that completely destroy the flexibility one needs in loading the dishwasher. The addition of the wash jets for the silverware basket and the silverware tray prevents removing the basket and using that section for pans or other large items. Plus the tray is entirely too small for more than a about a dozen pieces and normal sized silverware wont fit properly. Also, when you slide the 3rd rack in its akin to throwing darts in the dark. The "docking port" for the silverware jets isnt aligned well and it takes several attempts to get the parts to seat properly. Very poorly designed and zero thought given to flexibility. I am a GE fan and have a kitchen full of Profile appliances that have served me well however, I will not be considering GE during my kitchen remodel this summer. If you currently have Profile appliances and like them do NOT buy new ones until you look at them, I made that mistake and wont do that again. Thankfully I didnt pay full price for this dishwasher so the financial hit of replacing it in about 9 months wont sting as much as the disappointment in its low quality materials.

Sentence (English): Thank you to "Technician Cho Chang-young" for the dishwasher installation review.
Comments (English): Thank you to "Technician Cho Chang-young" for the dishwasher installation review. Living in a 40-year-old house, I purchased a dishwasher for a more comfortable life. I was worried that the installation would be difficult due to the old sewer system and low sink height, but meeting the installer, Cho Chang-young, all my concerns were transformed into a thrill. What you need for installation: a high-capacity power strip, dishwasher detergent, kitchen towels, and a rag. Problem 1) The induction cooktop and sink were flush, which was aesthetically pleasing. However, the sink was too low for the dishwasher installation, necessitating an induction stand. Considering the height of the induction cooktop and sink, he used a *2cm stand*. It worked perfectly for cooking and was aesthetically pleasing. My husband personally removed the food waste disposer, which was originally installed under the sink, re-installed the drain, and purchased a Y-pipe to connect it. Despite the complexities, the installer did his best to complete the installation. Problem 2) Even after a long installation, I discovered that the sink was not level. The sink top was low from the floor, making the installation difficult. Furthermore, I discovered that the sink top was warped downward between the sink bowl (faucet) and the induction cooktop. The installation took nearly three hours, but the technician was meticulous throughout. He even tied a toilet paper roll at the pipe connection to check for leaks, which was a true testament to his professionalism. He also demonstrated his continued dedication and after-sales service. After using the dishwasher for the first time on the evening of the first day, I noticed the toilet paper under the drain was wet. I sent him a text message and photos after 10 p.m. and the technician promised to visit the next day. He visited again the next day, and although the drain connection was brand new, he replaced it with a new one and re-tied the toilet paper roll. On the third day, he called to confirm the situation and, upon confirming the wet toilet paper, requested a third visit. During this third visit, he asked me detailed questions about the food waste disposal replacement process and listened to my feedback. Ace, a professional plumbing technician, visited the house, disassembled the drain again, identified the torn packing as the cause, and told me to replace it with a new one and try again. Finally, he re-wrapped the toilet paper and even called me on the fourth morning to confirm there were no leaks. The best technician! The best attitude! His meticulous and gentle demeanor! And his commitment to the job proved him to be the best in the field. It wasn't just the installation; I felt a genuine concern for the customer's life. Overall, I was so satisfied that he even cleaned a heat-resistant glass cup stained with herbal water, something I couldn't clean myself. But what made this experience so special was the dedication and attention to detail of Technician Cho Chang-young. It made me realize I should have left the repairs to a professional rather than my own family. I have no doubt that he poured his heart and soul into the repairs over multiple visits. Once again, I express my deepest gratitude to Cho Chang-young, the best installer.
Comments (Original): 식기세척기 설치 후기 – "조창영 기사님"께 감사드립니다40년 된 구가옥에 살고 있는 저는, 조금 더 편한 삶을 위해 식기세척기를 구입했습니다. 오래된 하수구조와 낮은 씽크대 높이 때문에 설치가 쉽지 않을 것이라 걱정했지만, 설치기사님 조창영 님을 만나면서 그 모든 우려가 감동으로 바뀌었습니다. 설치시 준비물 : 고대용량 멀티탭,  식세기세제,  키친타올,  걸레️ 문제1) 인덕션과 씽크대 상판이 같은 면이어서 미관상 좋았지만,  식세기 설치시 씽크대의 높이가 낮아 인덕션거치대가 꼭 필요한 상황이었음.  인덕션과 씽크대 상판 높이를 고려해 *2cm 거치대*를 사용해 주셨는데, 조리 시 불편함도 없고 디자인적으로도 전혀 거슬리지 않았습니다. 원래 씽크대 안쪽에 설치되어 있던 음식물처리기를 남편이 직접 제거하고 배수구를 다시 설치한 뒤 Y관을 구입해 연결했는데, 그 복잡한 상황 속에서도 기사님은 최선을 다해 설치를 진행해 주셨습니다.⏱️ 문제2) 긴 설치 시간에도 씽크대 높이 또한 수평이 맞지 않았음을 발견함.방바닥에서 씽크대상판의 높이가 낮아 작업이 쉽지 않았고, 씽크볼(수전)과 인덕션 사이의 씽크 상판이 아래로 휘어 있는 문제까지 발견되었습니다. 설치는 무려 3시간 가까이 걸렸지만, 기사님은 끝까지 꼼꼼히 작업을 이어가셨습니다. 특히 배관 연결부에 휴지를 매듭지어 누수를 체크하도록 해주신 섬세한 모습에서 진정한 전문가임을 느낄 수 있었습니다. 지속적인 사후 관리와 헌신 첫날 저녁 식세기 첫 사용 후 배수통 아래 휴지가 젖은 것을 확인하고 밤 10시가 넘은 시간에 문자와 사진을 보내드렸는데, 기사님은 바로 다음날 방문을 약속하셨습니다. 다음날 두 번째 방문하여 배수통 아래 연결 부위기 새제품이었지만 새로 다시 교체해 주셨고, 다시 휴지 매듭을 묶어두셨습니다. 셋째날 직접 확인 전화를 주셨고 또다시 휴지가 젖었음을 답하여 세 번째 방문을 새주셨습니다. 세 번째 방문에서는 음식물처리기 교체 과정까지 상세히 물어보시고 저의 답을 들어보시고는, 배수 전문 에이스 기사님도 방문하셔서 배수통을 다시 분해하여 찢어진 패킹을 원인으로 찾아내고 새로운 배수통으로 교체 후 사용해 보라고 하셨습니다. 마지막으로 다시 휴지를 묶어두고 넷째날 아침 직접 확인 전화까지 주셔서 누수가 없음을 함께 확인했습니다. 최고의 전문가!  최고의 태도!  섬세하고 상냥한 태도!  그리고 끝까지 책임지는 모습에서 이 분야 최고의 전문가임을 확인할 수 있었습니다.  단순히 설치가 아니라, 고객의 생활을 진심으로 배려하는 마음이 느껴졌습니다.총평제 손으로는 깨끗하게 설겆이 되지 않던 약초달인 물로 얼룩진 내열유리 컵까지 깨끗하게 세척해 줄 정도로 만족스럽습니다. 하지만 무엇보다 이번 경험을 특별하게 만든 것은 ***조창영 기사님***의 헌신과 섬세함이었습니다.그리고 가족 보다는 전문가에게 수리를 받아야 한다는 생각이 들었습니다. 여러 차례 방문하며 혼을 갈아 넣어 주신 그 진심을 저는 믿어 의심치 않습니다.다시 한 번, 최고의 설치 기사님 조창영 님께 깊은 감사를 드립니다.

Sentence (English): I was worried that the installation would be difficult due to the old sewer system and low sink height, but meeting the installer, Cho Chang-young, all my concerns were transformed into a thrill.
Comments (English): Thank you to "Technician Cho Chang-young" for the dishwasher installation review. Living in a 40-year-old house, I purchased a dishwasher for a more comfortable life. I was worried that the installation would be difficult due to the old sewer system and low sink height, but meeting the installer, Cho Chang-young, all my concerns were transformed into a thrill. What you need for installation: a high-capacity power strip, dishwasher detergent, kitchen towels, and a rag. Problem 1) The induction cooktop and sink were flush, which was aesthetically pleasing. However, the sink was too low for the dishwasher installation, necessitating an induction stand. Considering the height of the induction cooktop and sink, he used a *2cm stand*. It worked perfectly for cooking and was aesthetically pleasing. My husband personally removed the food waste disposer, which was originally installed under the sink, re-installed the drain, and purchased a Y-pipe to connect it. Despite the complexities, the installer did his best to complete the installation. Problem 2) Even after a long installation, I discovered that the sink was not level. The sink top was low from the floor, making the installation difficult. Furthermore, I discovered that the sink top was warped downward between the sink bowl (faucet) and the induction cooktop. The installation took nearly three hours, but the technician was meticulous throughout. He even tied a toilet paper roll at the pipe connection to check for leaks, which was a true testament to his professionalism. He also demonstrated his continued dedication and after-sales service. After using the dishwasher for the first time on the evening of the first day, I noticed the toilet paper under the drain was wet. I sent him a text message and photos after 10 p.m. and the technician promised to visit the next day. He visited again the next day, and although the drain connection was brand new, he replaced it with a new one and re-tied the toilet paper roll. On the third day, he called to confirm the situation and, upon confirming the wet toilet paper, requested a third visit. During this third visit, he asked me detailed questions about the food waste disposal replacement process and listened to my feedback. Ace, a professional plumbing technician, visited the house, disassembled the drain again, identified the torn packing as the cause, and told me to replace it with a new one and try again. Finally, he re-wrapped the toilet paper and even called me on the fourth morning to confirm there were no leaks. The best technician! The best attitude! His meticulous and gentle demeanor! And his commitment to the job proved him to be the best in the field. It wasn't just the installation; I felt a genuine concern for the customer's life. Overall, I was so satisfied that he even cleaned a heat-resistant glass cup stained with herbal water, something I couldn't clean myself. But what made this experience so special was the dedication and attention to detail of Technician Cho Chang-young. It made me realize I should have left the repairs to a professional rather than my own family. I have no doubt that he poured his heart and soul into the repairs over multiple visits. Once again, I express my deepest gratitude to Cho Chang-young, the best installer.

Sentence (English): Problem 1) The induction cooktop and sink were flush, which was aesthetically pleasing.
Comments (English): Thank you to "Technician Cho Chang-young" for the dishwasher installation review. Living in a 40-year-old house, I purchased a dishwasher for a more comfortable life. I was worried that the installation would be difficult due to the old sewer system and low sink height, but meeting the installer, Cho Chang-young, all my concerns were transformed into a thrill. What you need for installation: a high-capacity power strip, dishwasher detergent, kitchen towels, and a rag. Problem 1) The induction cooktop and sink were flush, which was aesthetically pleasing. However, the sink was too low for the dishwasher installation, necessitating an induction stand. Considering the height of the induction cooktop and sink, he used a *2cm stand*. It worked perfectly for cooking and was aesthetically pleasing. My husband personally removed the food waste disposer, which was originally installed under the sink, re-installed the drain, and purchased a Y-pipe to connect it. Despite the complexities, the installer did his best to complete the installation. Problem 2) Even after a long installation, I discovered that the sink was not level. The sink top was low from the floor, making the installation difficult. Furthermore, I discovered that the sink top was warped downward between the sink bowl (faucet) and the induction cooktop. The installation took nearly three hours, but the technician was meticulous throughout. He even tied a toilet paper roll at the pipe connection to check for leaks, which was a true testament to his professionalism. He also demonstrated his continued dedication and after-sales service. After using the dishwasher for the first time on the evening of the first day, I noticed the toilet paper under the drain was wet. I sent him a text message and photos after 10 p.m. and the technician promised to visit the next day. He visited again the next day, and although the drain connection was brand new, he replaced it with a new one and re-tied the toilet paper roll. On the third day, he called to confirm the situation and, upon confirming the wet toilet paper, requested a third visit. During this third visit, he asked me detailed questions about the food waste disposal replacement process and listened to my feedback. Ace, a professional plumbing technician, visited the house, disassembled the drain again, identified the torn packing as the cause, and told me to replace it with a new one and try again. Finally, he re-wrapped the toilet paper and even called me on the fourth morning to confirm there were no leaks. The best technician! The best attitude! His meticulous and gentle demeanor! And his commitment to the job proved him to be the best in the field. It wasn't just the installation; I felt a genuine concern for the customer's life. Overall, I was so satisfied that he even cleaned a heat-resistant glass cup stained with herbal water, something I couldn't clean myself. But what made this experience so special was the dedication and attention to detail of Technician Cho Chang-young. It made me realize I should have left the repairs to a professional rather than my own family. I have no doubt that he poured his heart and soul into the repairs over multiple visits. Once again, I express my deepest gratitude to Cho Chang-young, the best installer.

Sentence (English): Considering the height of the induction cooktop and sink, he used a *2cm stand*.
Comments (English): Thank you to "Technician Cho Chang-young" for the dishwasher installation review. Living in a 40-year-old house, I purchased a dishwasher for a more comfortable life. I was worried that the installation would be difficult due to the old sewer system and low sink height, but meeting the installer, Cho Chang-young, all my concerns were transformed into a thrill. What you need for installation: a high-capacity power strip, dishwasher detergent, kitchen towels, and a rag. Problem 1) The induction cooktop and sink were flush, which was aesthetically pleasing. However, the sink was too low for the dishwasher installation, necessitating an induction stand. Considering the height of the induction cooktop and sink, he used a *2cm stand*. It worked perfectly for cooking and was aesthetically pleasing. My husband personally removed the food waste disposer, which was originally installed under the sink, re-installed the drain, and purchased a Y-pipe to connect it. Despite the complexities, the installer did his best to complete the installation. Problem 2) Even after a long installation, I discovered that the sink was not level. The sink top was low from the floor, making the installation difficult. Furthermore, I discovered that the sink top was warped downward between the sink bowl (faucet) and the induction cooktop. The installation took nearly three hours, but the technician was meticulous throughout. He even tied a toilet paper roll at the pipe connection to check for leaks, which was a true testament to his professionalism. He also demonstrated his continued dedication and after-sales service. After using the dishwasher for the first time on the evening of the first day, I noticed the toilet paper under the drain was wet. I sent him a text message and photos after 10 p.m. and the technician promised to visit the next day. He visited again the next day, and although the drain connection was brand new, he replaced it with a new one and re-tied the toilet paper roll. On the third day, he called to confirm the situation and, upon confirming the wet toilet paper, requested a third visit. During this third visit, he asked me detailed questions about the food waste disposal replacement process and listened to my feedback. Ace, a professional plumbing technician, visited the house, disassembled the drain again, identified the torn packing as the cause, and told me to replace it with a new one and try again. Finally, he re-wrapped the toilet paper and even called me on the fourth morning to confirm there were no leaks. The best technician! The best attitude! His meticulous and gentle demeanor! And his commitment to the job proved him to be the best in the field. It wasn't just the installation; I felt a genuine concern for the customer's life. Overall, I was so satisfied that he even cleaned a heat-resistant glass cup stained with herbal water, something I couldn't clean myself. But what made this experience so special was the dedication and attention to detail of Technician Cho Chang-young. It made me realize I should have left the repairs to a professional rather than my own family. I have no doubt that he poured his heart and soul into the repairs over multiple visits. Once again, I express my deepest gratitude to Cho Chang-young, the best installer.

Sentence (English): My husband personally removed the food waste disposer, which was originally installed under the sink, re-installed the drain, and purchased a Y-pipe to connect it.
Comments (English): Thank you to "Technician Cho Chang-young" for the dishwasher installation review. Living in a 40-year-old house, I purchased a dishwasher for a more comfortable life. I was worried that the installation would be difficult due to the old sewer system and low sink height, but meeting the installer, Cho Chang-young, all my concerns were transformed into a thrill. What you need for installation: a high-capacity power strip, dishwasher detergent, kitchen towels, and a rag. Problem 1) The induction cooktop and sink were flush, which was aesthetically pleasing. However, the sink was too low for the dishwasher installation, necessitating an induction stand. Considering the height of the induction cooktop and sink, he used a *2cm stand*. It worked perfectly for cooking and was aesthetically pleasing. My husband personally removed the food waste disposer, which was originally installed under the sink, re-installed the drain, and purchased a Y-pipe to connect it. Despite the complexities, the installer did his best to complete the installation. Problem 2) Even after a long installation, I discovered that the sink was not level. The sink top was low from the floor, making the installation difficult. Furthermore, I discovered that the sink top was warped downward between the sink bowl (faucet) and the induction cooktop. The installation took nearly three hours, but the technician was meticulous throughout. He even tied a toilet paper roll at the pipe connection to check for leaks, which was a true testament to his professionalism. He also demonstrated his continued dedication and after-sales service. After using the dishwasher for the first time on the evening of the first day, I noticed the toilet paper under the drain was wet. I sent him a text message and photos after 10 p.m. and the technician promised to visit the next day. He visited again the next day, and although the drain connection was brand new, he replaced it with a new one and re-tied the toilet paper roll. On the third day, he called to confirm the situation and, upon confirming the wet toilet paper, requested a third visit. During this third visit, he asked me detailed questions about the food waste disposal replacement process and listened to my feedback. Ace, a professional plumbing technician, visited the house, disassembled the drain again, identified the torn packing as the cause, and told me to replace it with a new one and try again. Finally, he re-wrapped the toilet paper and even called me on the fourth morning to confirm there were no leaks. The best technician! The best attitude! His meticulous and gentle demeanor! And his commitment to the job proved him to be the best in the field. It wasn't just the installation; I felt a genuine concern for the customer's life. Overall, I was so satisfied that he even cleaned a heat-resistant glass cup stained with herbal water, something I couldn't clean myself. But what made this experience so special was the dedication and attention to detail of Technician Cho Chang-young. It made me realize I should have left the repairs to a professional rather than my own family. I have no doubt that he poured his heart and soul into the repairs over multiple visits. Once again, I express my deepest gratitude to Cho Chang-young, the best installer.

I sent him a text message and photos after 10 p.m. and the technician promised to visit the next day. But what made this experience so special was the dedication and attention to detail of Technician Cho Chang-young.
