Sentence (English): The installation took nearly three hours, but the technician was meticulous throughout.
Comments (English): Thank you to "Technician Cho Chang-young" for the dishwasher installation review. Living in a 40-year-old house, I purchased a dishwasher for a more comfortable life. I was worried that the installation would be difficult due to the old sewer system and low sink height, but meeting the installer, Cho Chang-young, all my concerns were transformed into a thrill. What you need for installation: a high-capacity power strip, dishwasher detergent, kitchen towels, and a rag. Problem 1) The induction cooktop and sink were flush, which was aesthetically pleasing. However, the sink was too low for the dishwasher installation, necessitating an induction stand. Considering the height of the induction cooktop and sink, he used a *2cm stand*. It worked perfectly for cooking and was aesthetically pleasing. My husband personally removed the food waste disposer, which was originally installed under the sink, re-installed the drain, and purchased a Y-pipe to connect it. Despite the complexities, the installer did his best to complete the installation. Problem 2) Even after a long installation, I discovered that the sink was not level. The sink top was low from the floor, making the installation difficult. Furthermore, I discovered that the sink top was warped downward between the sink bowl (faucet) and the induction cooktop. The installation took nearly three hours, but the technician was meticulous throughout. He even tied a toilet paper roll at the pipe connection to check for leaks, which was a true testament to his professionalism. He also demonstrated his continued dedication and after-sales service. After using the dishwasher for the first time on the evening of the first day, I noticed the toilet paper under the drain was wet. I sent him a text message and photos after 10 p.m. and the technician promised to visit the next day. He visited again the next day, and although the drain connection was brand new, he replaced it with a new one and re-tied the toilet paper roll. On the third day, he called to confirm the situation and, upon confirming the wet toilet paper, requested a third visit. During this third visit, he asked me detailed questions about the food waste disposal replacement process and listened to my feedback. Ace, a professional plumbing technician, visited the house, disassembled the drain again, identified the torn packing as the cause, and told me to replace it with a new one and try again. Finally, he re-wrapped the toilet paper and even called me on the fourth morning to confirm there were no leaks. The best technician! The best attitude! His meticulous and gentle demeanor! And his commitment to the job proved him to be the best in the field. It wasn't just the installation; I felt a genuine concern for the customer's life. Overall, I was so satisfied that he even cleaned a heat-resistant glass cup stained with herbal water, something I couldn't clean myself. But what made this experience so special was the dedication and attention to detail of Technician Cho Chang-young. It made me realize I should have left the repairs to a professional rather than my own family. I have no doubt that he poured his heart and soul into the repairs over multiple visits. Once again, I express my deepest gratitude to Cho Chang-young, the best installer.

Comments (English): Thank you to "Technician Cho Chang-young" for the dishwasher installation review. Living in a 40-year-old house, I purchased a dishwasher for a more comfortable life. I was worried that the installation would be difficult due to the old sewer system and low sink height, but meeting the installer, Cho Chang-young, all my concerns were transformed into a thrill. What you need for installation: a high-capacity power strip, dishwasher detergent, kitchen towels, and a rag. Problem 1) The induction cooktop and sink were flush, which was aesthetically pleasing. However, the sink was too low for the dishwasher installation, necessitating an induction stand. Considering the height of the induction cooktop and sink, he used a *2cm stand*. My husband personally removed the food waste disposer, which was originally installed under the sink, re-installed the drain, and purchased a Y-pipe to connect it. Despite the complexities, the installer did his best to complete the installation. Problem 2) Even after a long installation, I discovered that the sink was not level. I sent him a text message and photos after 10 p.m. and the technician promised to visit the next day. But what made this experience so special was the dedication and attention to detail of Technician Cho Chang-young. It made me realize I should have left the repairs to a professional rather than my own family. I have no doubt that he poured his heart and soul into the repairs over multiple visits. Once again, I express my deepest gratitude to Cho Chang-young, the best installer.

Comments (English): Thank you to "Technician Cho Chang-young" for the dishwasher installation review. Living in a 40-year-old house, I purchased a dishwasher for a more comfortable life. I was worried that the installation would be difficult due to the old sewer system and low sink height, but meeting the installer, Cho Chang-young, all my concerns were transformed into a thrill. What you need for installation: a high-capacity power strip, dishwasher detergent, kitchen towels, and a rag. Problem 1) The induction cooktop and sink were flush, which was aesthetically pleasing. However, the sink was too low for the dishwasher installation, necessitating an induction stand. Considering the height of the induction cooktop and sink, he used a *2cm stand*. It worked perfectly for cooking and was aesthetically pleasing. My husband personally removed the food waste disposer, which was originally installed under the sink, re-installed the drain, and purchased a Y-pipe to connect it. Despite the complexities, the installer did his best to complete the installation. Problem 2) Even after a long installation, I discovered that the sink was not level. The sink top was low from the floor, making the installation difficult. Furthermore, I discovered that the sink top was warped downward between the sink bowl (faucet) and the induction cooktop. The installation took nearly three hours, but the technician was meticulous throughout. He even tied a toilet paper roll at the pipe connection to check for leaks, which was a true testament to his professionalism. He also demonstrated his continued dedication and after-sales service. After using the dishwasher for the first time on the evening of the first day, I noticed the toilet paper under the drain was wet. I sent him a text message and photos after 10 p.m. and the technician promised to visit the next day. He visited again the next day, and although the drain connection was brand new, he replaced it with a new one and re-tied the toilet paper roll. On the third day, he called to confirm the situation and, upon confirming the wet toilet paper, requested a third visit. During this third visit, he asked me detailed questions about the food waste disposal replacement process and listened to my feedback. Ace, a professional plumbing technician, visited the house, disassembled the drain again, identified the torn packing as the cause, and told me to replace it with a new one and try again. Finally, he re-wrapped the toilet paper and even called me on the fourth morning to confirm there were no leaks. The best technician! The best attitude! His meticulous and gentle demeanor! And his commitment to the job proved him to be the best in the field. It wasn't just the installation; I felt a genuine concern for the customer's life. Overall, I was so satisfied that he even cleaned a heat-resistant glass cup stained with herbal water, something I couldn't clean myself. But what made this experience so special was the dedication and attention to detail of Technician Cho Chang-young. It made me realize I should have left the repairs to a professional rather than my own family. I have no doubt that he poured his heart and soul into the repairs over multiple visits. Once again, I express my deepest gratitude to Cho Chang-young, the best installer.

Comments (English): Thank you to "Technician Cho Chang-young" for the dishwasher installation review. Living in a 40-year-old house, I purchased a dishwasher for a more comfortable life. My husband personally removed the food waste disposer, which was originally installed under the sink, re-installed the drain, and purchased a Y-pipe to connect it. Despite the complexities, the installer did his best to complete the installation. Problem 2) Even after a long installation, I discovered that the sink was not level. I sent him a text message and photos after 10 p.m. and the technician promised to visit the next day. But what made this experience so special was the dedication and attention to detail of Technician Cho Chang-young. Sentence (English): Ace, a professional plumbing technician, visited the house, disassembled the drain again, identified the torn packing as the cause, and told me to replace it with a new one and try again.
Comments (English): Thank you to "Technician Cho Chang-young" for the dishwasher installation review. Living in a 40-year-old house, I purchased a dishwasher for a more comfortable life. I was worried that the installation would be difficult due to the old sewer system and low sink height, but meeting the installer, Cho Chang-young, all my concerns were transformed into a thrill. What you need for installation: a high-capacity power strip, dishwasher detergent, kitchen towels, and a rag. Problem 1) The induction cooktop and sink were flush, which was aesthetically pleasing. However, the sink was too low for the dishwasher installation, necessitating an induction stand. Considering the height of the induction cooktop and sink, he used a *2cm stand*. It worked perfectly for cooking and was aesthetically pleasing. My husband personally removed the food waste disposer, which was originally installed under the sink, re-installed the drain, and purchased a Y-pipe to connect it. Despite the complexities, the installer did his best to complete the installation. Problem 2) Even after a long installation, I discovered that the sink was not level. The sink top was low from the floor, making the installation difficult. Furthermore, I discovered that the sink top was warped downward between the sink bowl (faucet) and the induction cooktop. The installation took nearly three hours, but the technician was meticulous throughout. He even tied a toilet paper roll at the pipe connection to check for leaks, which was a true testament to his professionalism. He also demonstrated his continued dedication and after-sales service. After using the dishwasher for the first time on the evening of the first day, I noticed the toilet paper under the drain was wet. I sent him a text message and photos after 10 p.m. and the technician promised to visit the next day. He visited again the next day, and although the drain connection was brand new, he replaced it with a new one and re-tied the toilet paper roll. On the third day, he called to confirm the situation and, upon confirming the wet toilet paper, requested a third visit. During this third visit, he asked me detailed questions about the food waste disposal replacement process and listened to my feedback. Ace, a professional plumbing technician, visited the house, disassembled the drain again, identified the torn packing as the cause, and told me to replace it with a new one and try again. Finally, he re-wrapped the toilet paper and even called me on the fourth morning to confirm there were no leaks. The best technician! The best attitude! His meticulous and gentle demeanor! And his commitment to the job proved him to be the best in the field. It wasn't just the installation; I felt a genuine concern for the customer's life. Overall, I was so satisfied that he even cleaned a heat-resistant glass cup stained with herbal water, something I couldn't clean myself. But what made this experience so special was the dedication and attention to detail of Technician Cho Chang-young. It made me realize I should have left the repairs to a professional rather than my own family. I have no doubt that he poured his heart and soul into the repairs over multiple visits. Once again, I express my deepest gratitude to Cho Chang-young, the best installer.

Sentence (English): The best technician!
Comments (English): Thank you to "Technician Cho Chang-young" for the dishwasher installation review. Living in a 40-year-old house, I purchased a dishwasher for a more comfortable life. I was worried that the installation would be difficult due to the old sewer system and low sink height, but meeting the installer, Cho Chang-young, all my concerns were transformed into a thrill. What you need for installation: a high-capacity power strip, dishwasher detergent, kitchen towels, and a rag. Problem 1) The induction cooktop and sink were flush, which was aesthetically pleasing. However, the sink was too low for the dishwasher installation, necessitating an induction stand. Considering the height of the induction cooktop and sink, he used a *2cm stand*. It worked perfectly for cooking and was aesthetically pleasing. My husband personally removed the food waste disposer, which was originally installed under the sink, re-installed the drain, and purchased a Y-pipe to connect it. Despite the complexities, the installer did his best to complete the installation. Problem 2) Even after a long installation, I discovered that the sink was not level. The sink top was low from the floor, making the installation difficult. Furthermore, I discovered that the sink top was warped downward between the sink bowl (faucet) and the induction cooktop. The installation took nearly three hours, but the technician was meticulous throughout. He even tied a toilet paper roll at the pipe connection to check for leaks, which was a true testament to his professionalism. He also demonstrated his continued dedication and after-sales service. After using the dishwasher for the first time on the evening of the first day, I noticed the toilet paper under the drain was wet. I sent him a text message and photos after 10 p.m. and the technician promised to visit the next day. He visited again the next day, and although the drain connection was brand new, he replaced it with a new one and re-tied the toilet paper roll. On the third day, he called to confirm the situation and, upon confirming the wet toilet paper, requested a third visit. During this third visit, he asked me detailed questions about the food waste disposal replacement process and listened to my feedback. Ace, a professional plumbing technician, visited the house, disassembled the drain again, identified the torn packing as the cause, and told me to replace it with a new one and try again. Finally, he re-wrapped the toilet paper and even called me on the fourth morning to confirm there were no leaks. The best technician! The best attitude! His meticulous and gentle demeanor! And his commitment to the job proved him to be the best in the field. It wasn't just the installation; I felt a genuine concern for the customer's life. Overall, I was so satisfied that he even cleaned a heat-resistant glass cup stained with herbal water, something I couldn't clean myself. But what made this experience so special was the dedication and attention to detail of Technician Cho Chang-young. It made me realize I should have left the repairs to a professional rather than my own family. I have no doubt that he poured his heart and soul into the repairs over multiple visits. Once again, I express my deepest gratitude to Cho Chang-young, the best installer.

Sentence (English): His meticulous and gentle demeanor!
Comments (English): Thank you to "Technician Cho Chang-young" for the dishwasher installation review. Living in a 40-year-old house, I purchased a dishwasher for a more comfortable life. I was worried that the installation would be difficult due to the old sewer system and low sink height, but meeting the installer, Cho Chang-young, all my concerns were transformed into a thrill. What you need for installation: a high-capacity power strip, dishwasher detergent, kitchen towels, and a rag. Problem 1) The induction cooktop and sink were flush, which was aesthetically pleasing. However, the sink was too low for the dishwasher installation, necessitating an induction stand. Considering the height of the induction cooktop and sink, he used a *2cm stand*. It worked perfectly for cooking and was aesthetically pleasing. My husband personally removed the food waste disposer, which was originally installed under the sink, re-installed the drain, and purchased a Y-pipe to connect it. Despite the complexities, the installer did his best to complete the installation. Problem 2) Even after a long installation, I discovered that the sink was not level. The sink top was low from the floor, making the installation difficult. Furthermore, I discovered that the sink top was warped downward between the sink bowl (faucet) and the induction cooktop. The installation took nearly three hours, but the technician was meticulous throughout. He even tied a toilet paper roll at the pipe connection to check for leaks, which was a true testament to his professionalism. He also demonstrated his continued dedication and after-sales service. After using the dishwasher for the first time on the evening of the first day, I noticed the toilet paper under the drain was wet. I sent him a text message and photos after 10 p.m. and the technician promised to visit the next day. He visited again the next day, and although the drain connection was brand new, he replaced it with a new one and re-tied the toilet paper roll. On the third day, he called to confirm the situation and, upon confirming the wet toilet paper, requested a third visit. During this third visit, he asked me detailed questions about the food waste disposal replacement process and listened to my feedback. Ace, a professional plumbing technician, visited the house, disassembled the drain again, identified the torn packing as the cause, and told me to replace it with a new one and try again. Finally, he re-wrapped the toilet paper and even called me on the fourth morning to confirm there were no leaks. The best technician! The best attitude! His meticulous and gentle demeanor! And his commitment to the job proved him to be the best in the field. It wasn't just the installation; I felt a genuine concern for the customer's life. Overall, I was so satisfied that he even cleaned a heat-resistant glass cup stained with herbal water, something I couldn't clean myself. But what made this experience so special was the dedication and attention to detail of Technician Cho Chang-young. It made me realize I should have left the repairs to a professional rather than my own family. I have no doubt that he poured his heart and soul into the repairs over multiple visits. Once again, I express my deepest gratitude to Cho Chang-young, the best installer.

Sentence (English): And his commitment to the job proved him to be the best in the field.
Comments (English): Thank you to "Technician Cho Chang-young" for the dishwasher installation review. Living in a 40-year-old house, I purchased a dishwasher for a more comfortable life. I was worried that the installation would be difficult due to the old sewer system and low sink height, but meeting the installer, Cho Chang-young, all my concerns were transformed into a thrill. What you need for installation: a high-capacity power strip, dishwasher detergent, kitchen towels, and a rag. Problem 1) The induction cooktop and sink were flush, which was aesthetically pleasing. However, the sink was too low for the dishwasher installation, necessitating an induction stand. Considering the height of the induction cooktop and sink, he used a *2cm stand*. It worked perfectly for cooking and was aesthetically pleasing. My husband personally removed the food waste disposer, which was originally installed under the sink, re-installed the drain, and purchased a Y-pipe to connect it. Despite the complexities, the installer did his best to complete the installation. Problem 2) Even after a long installation, I discovered that the sink was not level. The sink top was low from the floor, making the installation difficult. Furthermore, I discovered that the sink top was warped downward between the sink bowl (faucet) and the induction cooktop. The installation took nearly three hours, but the technician was meticulous throughout. He even tied a toilet paper roll at the pipe connection to check for leaks, which was a true testament to his professionalism. He also demonstrated his continued dedication and after-sales service. After using the dishwasher for the first time on the evening of the first day, I noticed the toilet paper under the drain was wet. I sent him a text message and photos after 10 p.m. and the technician promised to visit the next day. He visited again the next day, and although the drain connection was brand new, he replaced it with a new one and re-tied the toilet paper roll. On the third day, he called to confirm the situation and, upon confirming the wet toilet paper, requested a third visit. During this third visit, he asked me detailed questions about the food waste disposal replacement process and listened to my feedback. Ace, a professional plumbing technician, visited the house, disassembled the drain again, identified the torn packing as the cause, and told me to replace it with a new one and try again. Finally, he re-wrapped the toilet paper and even called me on the fourth morning to confirm there were no leaks. The best technician! The best attitude! His meticulous and gentle demeanor! And his commitment to the job proved him to be the best in the field. It wasn't just the installation; I felt a genuine concern for the customer's life. Overall, I was so satisfied that he even cleaned a heat-resistant glass cup stained with herbal water, something I couldn't clean myself. But what made this experience so special was the dedication and attention to detail of Technician Cho Chang-young. It made me realize I should have left the repairs to a professional rather than my own family. I have no doubt that he poured his heart and soul into the repairs over multiple visits. Once again, I express my deepest gratitude to Cho Chang-young, the best installer.

Comments (English): Thank you to "Technician Cho Chang-young" for the dishwasher installation review. Living in a 40-year-old house, I purchased a dishwasher for a more comfortable life. I was worried that the installation would be difficult due to the old sewer system and low sink height, but meeting the installer, Cho Chang-young, all my concerns were transformed into a thrill. What you need for installation: a high-capacity power strip, dishwasher detergent, kitchen towels, and a rag. Problem 1) The induction cooktop and sink were flush, which was aesthetically pleasing. However, the sink was too low for the dishwasher installation, necessitating an induction stand. Considering the height of the induction cooktop and sink, he used a *2cm stand*. It worked perfectly for cooking and was aesthetically pleasing. My husband personally removed the food waste disposer, which was originally installed under the sink, re-installed the drain, and purchased a Y-pipe to connect it. Despite the complexities, the installer did his best to complete the installation. Problem 2) Even after a long installation, I discovered that the sink was not level. The sink top was low from the floor, making the installation difficult. Furthermore, I discovered that the sink top was warped downward between the sink bowl (faucet) and the induction cooktop. The installation took nearly three hours, but the technician was meticulous throughout. He even tied a toilet paper roll at the pipe connection to check for leaks, which was a true testament to his professionalism. He also demonstrated his continued dedication and after-sales service. After using the dishwasher for the first time on the evening of the first day, I noticed the toilet paper under the drain was wet. I sent him a text message and photos after 10 p.m. and the technician promised to visit the next day. He visited again the next day, and although the drain connection was brand new, he replaced it with a new one and re-tied the toilet paper roll. On the third day, he called to confirm the situation and, upon confirming the wet toilet paper, requested a third visit. During this third visit, he asked me detailed questions about the food waste disposal replacement process and listened to my feedback. Ace, a professional plumbing technician, visited the house, disassembled the drain again, identified the torn packing as the cause, and told me to replace it with a new one and try again. Finally, he re-wrapped the toilet paper and even called me on the fourth morning to confirm there were no leaks. The best technician! The best attitude! His meticulous and gentle demeanor! And his commitment to the job proved him to be the best in the field. It wasn't just the installation; I felt a genuine concern for the customer's life. Overall, I was so satisfied that he even cleaned a heat-resistant glass cup stained with herbal water, something I couldn't clean myself. But what made this experience so special was the dedication and attention to detail of Technician Cho Chang-young. It made me realize I should have left the repairs to a professional rather than my own family. I have no doubt that he poured his heart and soul into the repairs over multiple visits. Once again, I express my deepest gratitude to Cho Chang-young, the best installer.

Sentence (English): It made me realize I should have left the repairs to a professional rather than my own family.
Comments (English): Thank you to "Technician Cho Chang-young" for the dishwasher installation review. Living in a 40-year-old house, I purchased a dishwasher for a more comfortable life. I was worried that the installation would be difficult due to the old sewer system and low sink height, but meeting the installer, Cho Chang-young, all my concerns were transformed into a thrill. What you need for installation: a high-capacity power strip, dishwasher detergent, kitchen towels, and a rag. Problem 1) The induction cooktop and sink were flush, which was aesthetically pleasing. However, the sink was too low for the dishwasher installation, necessitating an induction stand. Considering the height of the induction cooktop and sink, he used a *2cm stand*. It worked perfectly for cooking and was aesthetically pleasing. My husband personally removed the food waste disposer, which was originally installed under the sink, re-installed the drain, and purchased a Y-pipe to connect it. Despite the complexities, the installer did his best to complete the installation. Problem 2) Even after a long installation, I discovered that the sink was not level. The sink top was low from the floor, making the installation difficult. Furthermore, I discovered that the sink top was warped downward between the sink bowl (faucet) and the induction cooktop. The installation took nearly three hours, but the technician was meticulous throughout. He even tied a toilet paper roll at the pipe connection to check for leaks, which was a true testament to his professionalism. He also demonstrated his continued dedication and after-sales service. After using the dishwasher for the first time on the evening of the first day, I noticed the toilet paper under the drain was wet. I sent him a text message and photos after 10 p.m. and the technician promised to visit the next day. He visited again the next day, and although the drain connection was brand new, he replaced it with a new one and re-tied the toilet paper roll. On the third day, he called to confirm the situation and, upon confirming the wet toilet paper, requested a third visit. During this third visit, he asked me detailed questions about the food waste disposal replacement process and listened to my feedback. Ace, a professional plumbing technician, visited the house, disassembled the drain again, identified the torn packing as the cause, and told me to replace it with a new one and try again. Finally, he re-wrapped the toilet paper and even called me on the fourth morning to confirm there were no leaks. The best technician! The best attitude! His meticulous and gentle demeanor! And his commitment to the job proved him to be the best in the field. It wasn't just the installation; I felt a genuine concern for the customer's life. Overall, I was so satisfied that he even cleaned a heat-resistant glass cup stained with herbal water, something I couldn't clean myself. But what made this experience so special was the dedication and attention to detail of Technician Cho Chang-young. It made me realize I should have left the repairs to a professional rather than my own family. I have no doubt that he poured his heart and soul into the repairs over multiple visits. Once again, I express my deepest gratitude to Cho Chang-young, the best installer.

Comments (English): Thank you to "Technician Cho Chang-young" for the dishwasher installation review. Living in a 40-year-old house, I purchased a dishwasher for a more comfortable life. What you need for installation: a high-capacity power strip, dishwasher detergent, kitchen towels, and a rag. Problem 1) The induction cooktop and sink were flush, which was aesthetically pleasing. However, the sink was too low for the dishwasher installation, necessitating an induction stand. Considering the height of the induction cooktop and sink, he used a *2cm stand*. It worked perfectly for cooking and was aesthetically pleasing. My husband personally removed the food waste disposer, which was originally installed under the sink, re-installed the drain, and purchased a Y-pipe to connect it. Despite the complexities, the installer did his best to complete the installation. Problem 2) Even after a long installation, I discovered that the sink was not level. The sink top was low from the floor, making the installation difficult. Furthermore, I discovered that the sink top was warped downward between the sink bowl (faucet) and the induction cooktop. The installation took nearly three hours, but the technician was meticulous throughout. He even tied a toilet paper roll at the pipe connection to check for leaks, which was a true testament to his professionalism. He also demonstrated his continued dedication and after-sales service. After using the dishwasher for the first time on the evening of the first day, I noticed the toilet paper under the drain was wet. I sent him a text message and photos after 10 p.m. and the technician promised to visit the next day. He visited again the next day, and although the drain connection was brand new, he replaced it with a new one and re-tied the toilet paper roll. On the third day, he called to confirm the situation and, upon confirming the wet toilet paper, requested a third visit. During this third visit, he asked me detailed questions about the food waste disposal replacement process and listened to my feedback. Ace, a professional plumbing technician, visited the house, disassembled the drain again, identified the torn packing as the cause, and told me to replace it with a new one and try again. Finally, he re-wrapped the toilet paper and even called me on the fourth morning to confirm there were no leaks. The best technician! The best attitude! His meticulous and gentle demeanor! And his commitment to the job proved him to be the best in the field. It wasn't just the installation; I felt a genuine concern for the customer's life. Overall, I was so satisfied that he even cleaned a heat-resistant glass cup stained with herbal water, something I couldn't clean myself. But what made this experience so special was the dedication and attention to detail of Technician Cho Chang-young. It made me realize I should have left the repairs to a professional rather than my own family. I have no doubt that he poured his heart and soul into the repairs over multiple visits. Once again, I express my deepest gratitude to Cho Chang-young, the best installer.

Sentence (English): Dishwasher Installation Review amp;ndash; amp;quot;Thank you to technician Jo Chang-young amp;quot;.
Comments (English): [ Dishwasher Installation Review amp;ndas ] || ---------------- || Dishwasher Installation Review amp;ndash; amp;quot;Thank you to technician Jo Chang-young amp;quot;. I live in a 40-year-old house and purchased a dishwasher to make my life a little more comfortable. I was worried that the installation would be difficult due to the old sewer system and low sink height, but after meeting the installer Jo Chang-young, all my worries were transformed into inspiration. Things to prepare for installation: high-capacity power strip, dishwasher detergent, kitchen towels, rags. Problem 1) The induction cooktop and sink top were flush, which was aesthetically pleasing, but the sink was low when installing the dishwasher, so an induction stand was absolutely necessary. Considering the height of the induction cooktop and sink top, they used a *2cm stand*, which was comfortable while cooking and did not detract from the design at all. My husband personally removed the food waste disposer, which was originally installed under the sink, reinstalled the drain, and connected it with a Y-pipe. Despite the complexities, the installer did his best to complete the installation. Problem 2) Even after a long installation, we discovered that the sink was not level. The sink top was low from the floor, making the job difficult. We also discovered that the sink top was warped between the sink bowl (faucet) and the induction cooktop. The installation took nearly three hours, but the installer was meticulous throughout. He even tied a toilet paper knot at the pipe connection to check for leaks, which was a true testament to his expertise. He also demonstrated his continued dedication and after-sales service. After using the dishwasher for the first time on the evening of the first day, I noticed wet toilet paper under the drain. I sent him a text message and photos after 10 p.m. and he promised to visit the next day. He returned the next day and replaced the new drain connection, and re-tied the toilet paper knot. On the third day, they called me to personally check, and again, when I told them the toilet paper was wet, they scheduled a third visit. During this third visit, they asked me detailed questions about the food waste disposal replacement process and listened to my answers. A professional, a drain specialist, also visited, disassembled the drain again, identified the torn packing as the cause, and told me to replace it with a new one and try again. Finally, they re-tie the toilet paper and called me on the fourth morning to confirm there were no leaks. The best professional! The best attitude! Detailed and friendly! Their commitment to the end proved they were the best in the field. It wasn't just the installation; I felt they truly cared for their customers. Overall, I was so satisfied that they even cleaned a heat-resistant glass cup stained with herbal water, something I couldn't clean myself. But what made this experience so special was the dedication and attention to detail of Technician Jo Chang-young. It made me realize I should have had the repairs done by a professional rather than a family member. I have no doubt that they truly poured their heart and soul into this repair over the course of their numerous visits. Once again, I would like to express my deepest gratitude to our top installer, Mr. Cho Chang-young.
Comments (Original): [ 식기세척기 설치 후기 amp;ndas ] || ---------------- || 식기세척기 설치 후기 amp;ndash; amp;quot;조창영 기사님amp;quot;께 감사드립니다40년 된 구가옥에 살고 있는 저는, 조금 더 편한 삶을 위해 식기세척기를 구입했습니다. 오래된 하수구조와 낮은 씽크대 높이 때문에 설치가 쉽지 않을 것이라 걱정했지만, 설치기사님 조창영 님을 만나면서 그 모든 우려가 감동으로 바뀌었습니다. 설치시 준비물 : 고대용량 멀티탭,  식세기세제,  키친타올,  걸레️ 문제1) 인덕션과 씽크대 상판이 같은 면이어서 미관상 좋았지만,  식세기 설치시 씽크대의 높이가 낮아 인덕션거치대가 꼭 필요한 상황이었음.  인덕션과 씽크대 상판 높이를 고려해 *2cm 거치대*를 사용해 주셨는데, 조리 시 불편함도 없고 디자인적으로도 전혀 거슬리지 않았습니다. 원래 씽크대 안쪽에 설치되어 있던 음식물처리기를 남편이 직접 제거하고 배수구를 다시 설치한 뒤 Y관을 구입해 연결했는데, 그 복잡한 상황 속에서도 기사님은 최선을 다해 설치를 진행해 주셨습니다.⏱️ 문제2) 긴 설치 시간에도 씽크대 높이 또한 수평이 맞지 않았음을 발견함.방바닥에서 씽크대상판의 높이가 낮아 작업이 쉽지 않았고, 씽크볼(수전)과 인덕션 사이의 씽크 상판이 아래로 휘어 있는 문제까지 발견되었습니다. 설치는 무려 3시간 가까이 걸렸지만, 기사님은 끝까지 꼼꼼히 작업을 이어가셨습니다. 특히 배관 연결부에 휴지를 매듭지어 누수를 체크하도록 해주신 섬세한 모습에서 진정한 전문가임을 느낄 수 있었습니다. 지속적인 사후 관리와 헌신 첫날 저녁 식세기 첫 사용 후 배수통 아래 휴지가 젖은 것을 확인하고 밤 10시가 넘은 시간에 문자와 사진을 보내드렸는데, 기사님은 바로 다음날 방문을 약속하셨습니다. 다음날 두 번째 방문하여 배수통 아래 연결 부위기 새제품이었지만 새로 다시 교체해 주셨고, 다시 휴지 매듭을 묶어두셨습니다. 셋째날 직접 확인 전화를 주셨고 또다시 휴지가 젖었음을 답하여 세 번째 방문을 새주셨습니다. 세 번째 방문에서는 음식물처리기 교체 과정까지 상세히 물어보시고 저의 답을 들어보시고는, 배수 전문 에이스 기사님도 방문하셔서 배수통을 다시 분해하여 찢어진 패킹을 원인으로 찾아내고 새로운 배수통으로 교체 후 사용해 보라고 하셨습니다. 마지막으로 다시 휴지를 묶어두고 넷째날 아침 직접 확인 전화까지 주셔서 누수가 없음을 함께 확인했습니다. 최고의 전문가!  최고의 태도!  섬세하고 상냥한 태도!  그리고 끝까지 책임지는 모습에서 이 분야 최고의 전문가임을 확인할 수 있었습니다.  단순히 설치가 아니라, 고객의 생활을 진심으로 배려하는 마음이 느껴졌습니다.총평제 손으로는 깨끗하게 설겆이 되지 않던 약초달인 물로 얼룩진 내열유리 컵까지 깨끗하게 세척해 줄 정도로 만족스럽습니다. 하지만 무엇보다 이번 경험을 특별하게 만든 것은 ***조창영 기사님***의 헌신과 섬세함이었습니다.그리고 가족 보다는 전문가에게 수리를 받아야 한다는 생각이 들었습니다. 여러 차례 방문하며 혼을 갈아 넣어 주신 그 진심을 저는 믿어 의심치 않습니다.다시 한 번, 최고의 설치 기사님 조창영 님께 깊은 감사를 드립니다.

Comments (English): [ Dishwasher Installation Review amp;ndas ] || ---------------- || Dishwasher Installation Review amp;ndash; amp;quot;Thank you to technician Jo Chang-young amp;quot;. I live in a 40-year-old house and purchased a dishwasher to make my life a little more comfortable. I was worried that the installation would be difficult due to the old sewer system and low sink height, but after meeting the installer Jo Chang-young, all my worries were transformed into inspiration. Things to prepare for installation: high-capacity power strip, dishwasher detergent, kitchen towels, rags. Problem 1) The induction cooktop and sink top were flush, which was aesthetically pleasing, but the sink was low when installing the dishwasher, so an induction stand was absolutely necessary. Considering the height of the induction cooktop and sink top, they used a *2cm stand*, which was comfortable while cooking and did not detract from the design at all. My husband personally removed the food waste disposer, which was originally installed under the sink, reinstalled the drain, and connected it with a Y-pipe. Despite the complexities, the installer did his best to complete the installation. Problem 2) Even after a long installation, we discovered that the sink was not level. The sink top was low from the floor, making the job difficult. We also discovered that the sink top was warped between the sink bowl (faucet) and the induction cooktop. The installation took nearly three hours, but the installer was meticulous throughout. He even tied a toilet paper knot at the pipe connection to check for leaks, which was a true testament to his expertise. He also demonstrated his continued dedication and after-sales service. After using the dishwasher for the first time on the evening of the first day, I noticed wet toilet paper under the drain. I sent him a text message and photos after 10 p.m. and he promised to visit the next day. He returned the next day and replaced the new drain connection, and re-tied the toilet paper knot. On the third day, they called me to personally check, and again, when I told them the toilet paper was wet, they scheduled a third visit. During this third visit, they asked me detailed questions about the food waste disposal replacement process and listened to my answers. A professional, a drain specialist, also visited, disassembled the drain again, identified the torn packing as the cause, and told me to replace it with a new one and try again. Finally, they re-tie the toilet paper and called me on the fourth morning to confirm there were no leaks. The best professional! The best attitude! Detailed and friendly! Their commitment to the end proved they were the best in the field. It wasn't just the installation; I felt they truly cared for their customers. Overall, I was so satisfied that they even cleaned a heat-resistant glass cup stained with herbal water, something I couldn't clean myself. But what made this experience so special was the dedication and attention to detail of Technician Jo Chang-young. It made me realize I should have had the repairs done by a professional rather than a family member. I have no doubt that they truly poured their heart and soul into this repair over the course of their numerous visits. Once again, I would like to express my deepest gratitude to our top installer, Mr. Cho Chang-young.

He even tied a toilet paper knot at the pipe connection to check for leaks, which was a true testament to his expertise. He also demonstrated his continued dedication and after-sales service. After using the dishwasher for the first time on the evening of the first day, I noticed wet toilet paper under the drain. I sent him a text message and photos after 10 p.m. and he promised to visit the next day. He returned the next day and replaced the new drain connection, and re-tied the toilet paper knot. On the third day, they called me to personally check, and again, when I told them the toilet paper was wet, they scheduled a third visit. During this third visit, they asked me detailed questions about the food waste disposal replacement process and listened to my answers. A professional, a drain specialist, also visited, disassembled the drain again, identified the torn packing as the cause, and told me to replace it with a new one and try again. Finally, they re-tie the toilet paper and called me on the fourth morning to confirm there were no leaks. The best professional! The best attitude! Detailed and friendly! Their commitment to the end proved they were the best in the field. It wasn't just the installation; I felt they truly cared for their customers. Overall, I was so satisfied that they even cleaned a heat-resistant glass cup stained with herbal water, something I couldn't clean myself. But what made this experience so special was the dedication and attention to detail of Technician Jo Chang-young. It made me realize I should have had the repairs done by a professional rather than a family member. I have no doubt that they truly poured their heart and soul into this repair over the course of their numerous visits. Once again, I would like to express my deepest gratitude to our top installer, Mr. Cho Chang-young.

Finally, they re-tie the toilet paper and called me on the fourth morning to confirm there were no leaks. The best professional! The best attitude! Detailed and friendly! Once again, I would like to express my deepest gratitude to our top installer, Mr. Cho Chang-young.

During this third visit, they asked me detailed questions about the food waste disposal replacement process and listened to my answers. A professional, a drain specialist, also visited, disassembled the drain again, identified the torn packing as the cause, and told me to replace it with a new one and try again. Finally, they re-tie the toilet paper and called me on the fourth morning to confirm there were no leaks. The best professional! The best attitude! Detailed and friendly! I have no doubt that they truly poured their heart and soul into this repair over the course of their numerous visits. Once again, I would like to express my deepest gratitude to our top installer, Mr. Cho Chang-young.

I sent him a text message and photos after 10 p.m. and he promised to visit the next day. He returned the next day and replaced the new drain connection, and re-tied the toilet paper knot. On the third day, they called me to personally check, and again, when I told them the toilet paper was wet, they scheduled a third visit. During this third visit, they asked me detailed questions about the food waste disposal replacement process and listened to my answers. A professional, a drain specialist, also visited, disassembled the drain again, identified the torn packing as the cause, and told me to replace it with a new one and try again. Finally, they re-tie the toilet paper and called me on the fourth morning to confirm there were no leaks. The best professional! The best attitude! Detailed and friendly! Their commitment to the end proved they were the best in the field. It wasn't just the installation; I felt they truly cared for their customers. Overall, I was so satisfied that they even cleaned a heat-resistant glass cup stained with herbal water, something I couldn't clean myself. But what made this experience so special was the dedication and attention to detail of Technician Jo Chang-young. It made me realize I should have had the repairs done by a professional rather than a family member. I have no doubt that they truly poured their heart and soul into this repair over the course of their numerous visits. Once again, I would like to express my deepest gratitude to our top installer, Mr. Cho Chang-young.

Finally, they re-tie the toilet paper and called me on the fourth morning to confirm there were no leaks. The best professional! The best attitude! Detailed and friendly! Once again, I would like to express my deepest gratitude to our top installer, Mr. Cho Chang-young.

Finally, they re-tie the toilet paper and called me on the fourth morning to confirm there were no leaks. The best professional! The best attitude! Detailed and friendly! I have no doubt that they truly poured their heart and soul into this repair over the course of their numerous visits. Once again, I would like to express my deepest gratitude to our top installer, Mr. Cho Chang-young.

Sentence (English): Granted, this replaced an old and weary Bosch, but the improvement is incredible: Everything I put it in comes out shiny clean, dry, and because of the automatic door-opening feature: no pooled water anywhere and dishes are cool enough to be unloaded almost immediately.
Comments (English): [ Excellent in Every Category ] || ---------------- || Granted, this replaced an old and weary Bosch, but the improvement is incredible: Everything I put it in comes out shiny clean, dry, and because of the automatic door-opening feature: no pooled water anywhere and dishes are cool enough to be unloaded almost immediately. It is also whisper-quiet— we have to check to make sure it's even running.The third rack (which has its own set of jets) is fantastic! I put everything small up there: shot glasses, espresso cups and saucers, etc., plus anything that I want away from the heating element. Everything comes out clean and neither melted nor warped, including the steel and plastic attachments for my stand mixer.Only downsides: while the Printshield coating does not show fingerprints, it can't hide water drips from wet hands opening the door. A minor inconvenience that is easily wiped up. Also, the door opens about 5 inches in the last 2 seconds of the dry cycle to release steam. A fantastic feature! The open door, a small blue light on the front, and a small display reading “clean” are the indications it's clean. (Really, it does such a fantastic job that you can tell the dishes are clean just by looking at them.) However, once you close the door, all these clean indicators go away. I bought a $5 magnet that says Clean / Dirty and put it on the front. Easy fix.Thrilled with this purchase!

Comments (English): [ Dishwasher Installation Review amp;amp; ] || ---------------- || Dishwasher Installation Review amp;amp;amp;ndash; amp;amp;amp;quot;Thank you to technician Jo Chang-young. I live in a 40-year-old house and bought a dishwasher to make my life a little more comfortable. Considering the height of the induction cooktop and sink top, they used a *2cm stand*, which was comfortable while cooking and did not detract from the design at all. My husband personally removed the food waste disposer, which was originally installed under the sink, reinstalled the drain, and connected it with a Y-pipe. Despite the complexities, the installer did his best to complete the installation. Problem 2) Even after a long installation, we discovered that the sink was not level. The sink top was low from the floor, making the job difficult. We also discovered that the sink top was warped between the sink bowl (faucet) and the induction cooktop. The installation took nearly three hours, but the installer was meticulous throughout. He even tied a toilet paper knot at the pipe connection to check for leaks, which was a true testament to his expertise. He also demonstrated his continued dedication and after-sales service. After using the dishwasher for the first time on the evening of the first day, I noticed wet toilet paper under the drain. I sent him a text message and photos after 10 p.m. and he promised to visit the next day. He returned the next day and replaced the new drain connection, and re-tied the toilet paper knot. On the third day, they called me to personally check, and again, when I told them the toilet paper was wet, they scheduled a third visit. During this third visit, they asked me detailed questions about the food waste disposal replacement process and listened to my answers. A professional, a drain specialist, also visited, disassembled the drain again, identified the torn packing as the cause, and told me to replace it with a new one and try again. Finally, they re-tie the toilet paper and called me on the fourth morning to confirm there were no leaks. The best professional! The best attitude! Detailed and friendly! Their commitment to the end proved they were the best in the field. It wasn't just the installation; I felt they truly cared for their customers. Overall, I was so satisfied that they even cleaned a heat-resistant glass cup stained with herbal water, something I couldn't clean myself. But what made this experience so special was the dedication and attention to detail of Technician Jo Chang-young. It made me realize I should have had the repairs done by a professional rather than a family member. I have no doubt that they truly poured their heart and soul into this repair over the course of their numerous visits. Once again, a huge thank you to our top-notch installer, Cho Chang-young. Additional notes after 10 uses. Cons: 1) The power button is too sensitive—it triggers even with the slightest touch. 2) It doesn't support 5G—it works with LG ThinQ—but it doesn't notify you when it's starting or ending. However, it's easily wiped clean, so it's forgivable.

Comments (English): [ Dishwasher Installation Review amp;amp; ] || ---------------- || Dishwasher Installation Review amp;amp;amp;ndash; amp;amp;amp;quot;Thank you to technician Jo Chang-young. I live in a 40-year-old house and bought a dishwasher to make my life a little more comfortable. I was worried that the installation would be difficult due to the old sewer system and low sink height, but after meeting the installer Jo Chang-young, all my worries were transformed into inspiration. Things to prepare for installation: a high-capacity power strip, dishwasher detergent, kitchen towels, and a rag. Problem 1) The induction cooktop and sink top were flush, which was aesthetically pleasing, but the sink was low when installing the dishwasher, so an induction stand was absolutely necessary. Considering the height of the induction cooktop and sink top, they used a *2cm stand*, which was comfortable while cooking and did not detract from the design at all. My husband personally removed the food waste disposer, which was originally installed under the sink, reinstalled the drain, and connected it with a Y-pipe. Despite the complexities, the installer did his best to complete the installation. Problem 2) Even after a long installation, we discovered that the sink was not level. The sink top was low from the floor, making the job difficult. We also discovered that the sink top was warped between the sink bowl (faucet) and the induction cooktop. The installation took nearly three hours, but the installer was meticulous throughout. He even tied a toilet paper knot at the pipe connection to check for leaks, which was a true testament to his expertise. He also demonstrated his continued dedication and after-sales service. After using the dishwasher for the first time on the evening of the first day, I noticed wet toilet paper under the drain. I sent him a text message and photos after 10 p.m. and he promised to visit the next day. He returned the next day and replaced the new drain connection, and re-tied the toilet paper knot. On the third day, they called me to personally check, and again, when I told them the toilet paper was wet, they scheduled a third visit. During this third visit, they asked me detailed questions about the food waste disposal replacement process and listened to my answers. A professional, a drain specialist, also visited, disassembled the drain again, identified the torn packing as the cause, and told me to replace it with a new one and try again. Finally, they re-tie the toilet paper and called me on the fourth morning to confirm there were no leaks. The best professional! The best attitude! Detailed and friendly! Their commitment to the end proved they were the best in the field. It wasn't just the installation; I felt they truly cared for their customers. Overall, I was so satisfied that they even cleaned a heat-resistant glass cup stained with herbal water, something I couldn't clean myself. But what made this experience so special was the dedication and attention to detail of Technician Jo Chang-young. It made me realize I should have had the repairs done by a professional rather than a family member. I have no doubt that they truly poured their heart and soul into this repair over the course of their numerous visits. Once again, a huge thank you to our top-notch installer, Cho Chang-young. Additional notes after 10 uses. Cons: 1) The power button is too sensitive—it triggers even with the slightest touch. 2) It doesn't support 5G—it works with LG ThinQ—but it doesn't notify you when it's starting or ending. However, it's easily wiped clean, so it's forgivable.

Sentence (English): I bought this as a replacement for a different brand dishwasher that had died.
Comments (English): [ Great base model ] || ---------------- || I bought this as a replacement for a different brand dishwasher that had died. Friends had recommended Bosch, so I decided on the 100 Series as it seemed like the greatest value for price. After install, I wish I would have upgraded to the 300 series since it has the third rack. I didn't have a third rack in the last dishwasher so I didn't think it would be useful. But the silverware holder that this comes with is smaller than I expected. Overall it holds what I need, and I am amazed at how clean the dishes are. Also, the drying works great. In the past where plastic lids came out wet, they no longer do with the Bosch.(I do use JetDry). Finally, I had felt like the wi-fi connection would be more of a gimmick but I like the functionality gained from using it. Like seeing an exact estimate of time to finish the cycle, and selecting the half-load and extra dry settings.

Sentence (English): I hate to leave a bad review, but I have to.
Comments (English): [ Keep your old school dishwasher! ] || ---------------- || I hate to leave a bad review, but I have to. This is the biggest piece of garbage dishwasher we've ever had. We replaced a 20 plus year old Whirlpool that never gave us one ounce of trouble during that 20 years, until the pump finally burned out. We've had COUNTLESS issues with this one already and we've only owned it for 1 year. As the old saying goes, they don't make them like they used to! My son just replaced the identical dishwasher in his house that he was able to get maybe 7 years out of. Thankfully he still had it because I had to use some of the parts off of his that were actually more robust, including all the mounting hardware and the bottom cover, which on his was steel, but on ours was super flimsy plastic. The mounting hardware was actually absolutely useless thin tin on this brand new unit, but thankfully he still had his, which as of 7 years or so ago was still built the way it should have been. Most of the plastic inside the unit is junk, as well. I had to retrofit the utensils basket from our old Whirlpool into this because the bottom was breaking out of the GE unit (his, too! ), and then the top impeller melted after it popped off its mount during a run cycle (thankfully I had a spare! ). Plus, every now and then the soap dispenser door will not open up during a cycle. I've contacted GE about this and the remedy is to kick the power off at the breaker for 15 minutes or so, which allows it to reset itself. Just like most modern day appliances, this thing is electronic and has a motherboard that is obviously very finicky! On the plus side, the controls are fairly easy to operate. Otherwise, you've been warned!

Finally, we love the steel look of the interior and the unique tones that ring when beginning and ending a wash. I know this sounds like I was paid to say all things great about this dishwasher, but the truth is, it IS a great dishwasher. Our hope is that it continues to work well for 10-15 years.

Sentence (English): So unsurprisingly our Samsung died almost on que, ten years after buying, much like the Washing machine that was a few months older, the Samsung Dishwasher had been having issues for a while with the door mechanism, then finally flashed the dreaded code for failed water heater.
Comments (English): So unsurprisingly our Samsung died almost on que, ten years after buying, much like the Washing machine that was a few months older, the Samsung Dishwasher had been having issues for a while with the door mechanism, then finally flashed the dreaded code for failed water heater. Given the time of year and limited funds these days, the nice fancy Bosch wasn't an option, and considering we not long ago got a Haier Washer that is perfectly ok, we figured either we get another Samsung, or we try out this brand and see how we go. It did take nearly two weeks to come, which I was quite disappointed about, looking at your Farmers.co.nz, you should carry stock. but I digress. From the outset you can see this dishwasher is cheaper, the sliding drawers are a bit clunky and are far from smooth, the height adjust for the top shelf is really weird and is not even close to the quality of the same thing on a samsung or better, rather you sort of have to pull it right out then wedge it back onto the runners on different wheels, very odd, a drawer with some brackets on the side would be so much easier Haier and it can't cost so much more surely. There is no water leak guard device built into the inlet hose so you're connect direct from the tap to the machine which lets hope isn't a problem is this town with very high water pressure.The overall design however if fine, its a nice colour, Satina, which is basically a plastic version of grey stainless steel, kinda. The buttons are all touch, and the controls are simple and make sense, you cycle through by way of a small orange LED above each option, Auto, Heavy, Medium, Glass etc etc, and below those you have the 'modifier' options which include extra dry (Awesome), Sanitise and a couple of others. It has six cycles, plus the four modifiers, so you do get plenty of options. Internally the baskets are average sized, the top one has a few tilted spaces for glass and cups etc, plus racks for plates, bowls so long as they aren't too big, none of the tines on the top rack are able to be moved so you're stuck with what Haier think a top rack should be. The bottom rack has two rows, the back row is adjustable and each set of tines can be lowered completely, but the front row which takes up half the width cannot be. The dishwasher cleaner dispenser is on the right side of the door and has a slide up, not a pop open, option, so you can I guess stack a tallish plate in there and it will still open and pop out your cleaner of choice. The left side is a blank space where the basket for cuttlery sits, its adequate, though lacks much space for utensils, and the little squares designed to hold cuttlery are small, so if you have knives or forks etc with wide handles you may also encounter a challenge wedging them in there. You do have to jiggly the utensils and cuttlery about abit as you load the machine to prevent taller items and the middle spray arm having a wee accident. On the topic of spray arms there are three, one at the bottom pointing up, one in the middle which appears to direct water both up and down, and at the very top of the machine is another smallish arm that appears to direct more water down onto items in the top basket primarily. The additional third/upper spray arm is a nice to have, normal on higher end machines I think, so an unexpected item here.In terms of cleaning performance, I cannot fault it so far. For day to day dinner ware, cups, glasses and all the usual things this machine has performed very well. We use those blue and yellow tabs with the red spot, so not the posh ones, but also not just plain powder. I add rinse aid though in theory shouldn't need to, and the machine enables you to adjust the dose of rinse aid and the instructions are clearly shown in the user manual. I haven't yet had a single item come out not sparkly clean, I cannot fault the quality of the clean so far, and have mostly used either the medium or 60 min cycle, with the extra dry option. I haven't put anything too challenging in there, maybe the baskets from the airfryer are the worst, but i do hand wash these first, it will be interesting to see what its performance is like over the coming christmas rush, anything is possible.This Haier allows a number of other features from higher end machines, including the door that opens (quite a lot) at the almost end of the cycle, it seems to rely primarily on that to dry dishes, but you can turn this opening off so it would be interesting to see how well it dries if the door stays shut. It also has WIFI control by way of the SmartHQ app which I believe is the one Haier uses, it enables you to remotely turn on the machine, select the cycle and the add-ons and then start it, you can also use the timer via the app or on the machine to schedule the start time to take advantage of free or cheaper power.My only real criticism of this machine is that it is in my view too loud. Where we have it installed one side as well as the front are open/exposed, so it is not fully enclosed in an under bench space, we had to remove the top section which I guess isn't all that unusual, but there isn't a lot of padding in there to dampen sound, and you can certainly hear it when it is running, the configuration of dishes within seems to make no odds, nor does the load size generally, its just not a quiet machine in my situation. Maybe if it were built in on all sides the noise would be dampened more by cupboards as others do say it is very quiet. That is however my only critique of it, its cleaning performance has been excellent, the choice of cycles is good and more than meets our every day needs. Personally I have no hesitation in recommending a Haier product, both of the ones we now have, plus a dryer actually, have all been purchased in 2025, so it will be interesting to see if they make it to 2035.

Given the time of year and limited funds these days, the nice fancy Bosch wasn't an option, and considering we not long ago got a Haier Washer that is perfectly ok, we figured either we get another Samsung, or we try out this brand and see how we go. It did take nearly two weeks to come, which I was quite disappointed about, looking at your Farmers.co.nz, you should carry stock. but I digress. From the outset you can see this dishwasher is cheaper, the sliding drawers are a bit clunky and are far from smooth, the height adjust for the top shelf is really weird and is not even close to the quality of the same thing on a samsung or better, rather you sort of have to pull it right out then wedge it back onto the runners on different wheels, very odd, a drawer with some brackets on the side would be so much easier Haier and it can't cost so much more surely. There is no water leak guard device built into the inlet hose so you're connect direct from the tap to the machine which lets hope isn't a problem is this town with very high water pressure.The overall design however if fine, its a nice colour, Satina, which is basically a plastic version of grey stainless steel, kinda. The buttons are all touch, and the controls are simple and make sense, you cycle through by way of a small orange LED above each option, Auto, Heavy, Medium, Glass etc etc, and below those you have the 'modifier' options which include extra dry (Awesome), Sanitise and a couple of others. It has six cycles, plus the four modifiers, so you do get plenty of options. Internally the baskets are average sized, the top one has a few tilted spaces for glass and cups etc, plus racks for plates, bowls so long as they aren't too big, none of the tines on the top rack are able to be moved so you're stuck with what Haier think a top rack should be. The bottom rack has two rows, the back row is adjustable and each set of tines can be lowered completely, but the front row which takes up half the width cannot be. The dishwasher cleaner dispenser is on the right side of the door and has a slide up, not a pop open, option, so you can I guess stack a tallish plate in there and it will still open and pop out your cleaner of choice. The left side is a blank space where the basket for cuttlery sits, its adequate, though lacks much space for utensils, and the little squares designed to hold cuttlery are small, so if you have knives or forks etc with wide handles you may also encounter a challenge wedging them in there. You do have to jiggly the utensils and cuttlery about abit as you load the machine to prevent taller items and the middle spray arm having a wee accident. On the topic of spray arms there are three, one at the bottom pointing up, one in the middle which appears to direct water both up and down, and at the very top of the machine is another smallish arm that appears to direct more water down onto items in the top basket primarily. The additional third/upper spray arm is a nice to have, normal on higher end machines I think, so an unexpected item here.In terms of cleaning performance, I cannot fault it so far. For day to day dinner ware, cups, glasses and all the usual things this machine has performed very well. We use those blue and yellow tabs with the red spot, so not the posh ones, but also not just plain powder. I add rinse aid though in theory shouldn't need to, and the machine enables you to adjust the dose of rinse aid and the instructions are clearly shown in the user manual. I haven't yet had a single item come out not sparkly clean, I cannot fault the quality of the clean so far, and have mostly used either the medium or 60 min cycle, with the extra dry option. I haven't put anything too challenging in there, maybe the baskets from the airfryer are the worst, but i do hand wash these first, it will be interesting to see what its performance is like over the coming christmas rush, anything is possible.This Haier allows a number of other features from higher end machines, including the door that opens (quite a lot) at the almost end of the cycle, it seems to rely primarily on that to dry dishes, but you can turn this opening off so it would be interesting to see how well it dries if the door stays shut. It also has WIFI control by way of the SmartHQ app which I believe is the one Haier uses, it enables you to remotely turn on the machine, select the cycle and the add-ons and then start it, you can also use the timer via the app or on the machine to schedule the start time to take advantage of free or cheaper power.My only real criticism of this machine is that it is in my view too loud. Where we have it installed one side as well as the front are open/exposed, so it is not fully enclosed in an under bench space, we had to remove the top section which I guess isn't all that unusual, but there isn't a lot of padding in there to dampen sound, and you can certainly hear it when it is running, the configuration of dishes within seems to make no odds, nor does the load size generally, its just not a quiet machine in my situation. Maybe if it were built in on all sides the noise would be dampened more by cupboards as others do say it is very quiet. That is however my only critique of it, its cleaning performance has been excellent, the choice of cycles is good and more than meets our every day needs. Personally I have no hesitation in recommending a Haier product, both of the ones we now have, plus a dryer actually, have all been purchased in 2025, so it will be interesting to see if they make it to 2035.

There is no water leak guard device built into the inlet hose so you're connect direct from the tap to the machine which lets hope isn't a problem is this town with very high water pressure.The overall design however if fine, its a nice colour, Satina, which is basically a plastic version of grey stainless steel, kinda.  The buttons are all touch, and the controls are simple and make sense, you cycle through by way of a small orange LED above each option, Auto, Heavy, Medium, Glass etc etc, and below those you have the 'modifier' options which include extra dry (Awesome), Sanitise and a couple of others.  It has six cycles, plus the four modifiers, so you do get plenty of options. Internally the baskets are average sized, the top one has a few tilted spaces for glass and cups etc, plus racks for plates, bowls so long as they aren't too big, none of the tines on the top rack are able to be moved so you're stuck with what Haier think a top rack should be.  The bottom rack has two rows, the back row is adjustable and each set of tines can be lowered completely, but the front row which takes up half the width cannot be.  The dishwasher cleaner dispenser is on the right side of the door and has a slide up, not a pop open, option, so you can I guess stack a tallish plate in there and it will still open and pop out your cleaner of choice.  The left side is a blank space where the basket for cuttlery sits, its adequate, though lacks much space for utensils, and the little squares designed to hold cuttlery are small, so if you have knives or forks etc with wide handles you may also encounter a challenge wedging them in there.  You do have to jiggly the utensils and cuttlery about abit as you load the machine to prevent taller items and the middle spray arm having a wee accident.  On the topic of spray arms there are three, one at the bottom pointing up, one in the middle which appears to direct water both up and down, and at the very top of the machine is another smallish arm that appears to direct more water down onto items in the top basket primarily.  The additional third/upper spray arm is a nice to have, normal on higher end machines I think, so an unexpected item here.In terms of cleaning performance, I cannot fault it so far.  For day to day dinner ware, cups, glasses and all the usual things this machine has performed very well.  We use those blue and yellow tabs with the red spot, so not the posh ones, but also not just plain powder.  I add rinse aid though in theory shouldn't need to, and the machine enables you to adjust the dose of rinse aid and the instructions are clearly shown in the user manual.  I haven't yet had a single item come out not sparkly clean, I cannot fault the quality of the clean so far, and have mostly used either the medium or 60 min cycle, with the extra dry option. I haven't put anything too challenging in there, maybe the baskets from the airfryer are the worst, but i do hand wash these first, it will be interesting to see what its performance is like over the coming christmas rush, anything is possible.This Haier allows a number of other features from higher end machines, including the door that opens (quite a lot) at the almost end of the cycle, it seems to rely primarily on that to dry dishes, but you can turn this opening off so it would be interesting to see how well it dries if the door stays shut.  It also has WIFI control by way of the SmartHQ app which I believe is the one Haier uses, it enables you to remotely turn on the machine, select the cycle and the add-ons and then start it, you can also use the timer via the app or on the machine to schedule the start time to take advantage of free or cheaper power.My only real criticism of this machine is that it is in my view too loud.  Where we have it installed one side as well as the front are open/exposed, so it is not fully enclosed in an under bench space, we had to remove the top section which I guess isn't all that unusual, but there isn't a lot of padding in there to dampen sound, and you can certainly hear it when it is running, the configuration of dishes within seems to make no odds, nor does the load size generally, its just not a quiet machine in my situation.  Maybe if it were built in on all sides the noise would be dampened more by cupboards as others do say it is very quiet.  That is however my only critique of it, its cleaning performance has been excellent, the choice of cycles is good and more than meets our every day needs. There is no water leak guard device built into the inlet hose so you're connect direct from the tap to the machine which lets hope isn't a problem is this town with very high water pressure.The overall design however if fine, its a nice colour, Satina, which is basically a plastic version of grey stainless steel, kinda. The buttons are all touch, and the controls are simple and make sense, you cycle through by way of a small orange LED above each option, Auto, Heavy, Medium, Glass etc etc, and below those you have the 'modifier' options which include extra dry (Awesome), Sanitise and a couple of others. It has six cycles, plus the four modifiers, so you do get plenty of options. Internally the baskets are average sized, the top one has a few tilted spaces for glass and cups etc, plus racks for plates, bowls so long as they aren't too big, none of the tines on the top rack are able to be moved so you're stuck with what Haier think a top rack should be. The bottom rack has two rows, the back row is adjustable and each set of tines can be lowered completely, but the front row which takes up half the width cannot be. You do have to jiggly the utensils and cuttlery about abit as you load the machine to prevent taller items and the middle spray arm having a wee accident.
